### Load Data and Prepare Datasets

```{r, warning=FALSE}

# --- Load data ---
covariate_stack <- rast("../LOCAL DATA DO NOT PUSH/covariate_stack/covariate_stack_3m.tif")
soil_covariate_data_scaled_SP <- read.csv("../LOCAL DATA DO NOT PUSH/covariates_and_soil_data/soil_covariate_data_scaled_SP.csv")
soil_covariate_data_scaled_C  <- read.csv("../LOCAL DATA DO NOT PUSH/covariates_and_soil_data/soil_covariate_data_scaled_C.csv")

# Load carbon + nitrogen dataset
soil_with_CN <- read_csv("../LOCAL DATA DO NOT PUSH/carbon/soil_data_with_CN.csv") %>%
  rename(c = leco_carbon_average,
         n = leco_nitrogen_average)

# Split by sampling type
SP_soil_with_CN <- soil_with_CN %>% filter(type == "SPID")
C_soil_with_CN  <- soil_with_CN %>% filter(type == "CID")

# Merge CN values into soil covariate tables by x,y coordinate
soil_SP_full <- soil_covariate_data_scaled_SP %>%
  left_join(SP_soil_with_CN %>% select(x,y,c,n), by=c("x","y"))

soil_C_full <- soil_covariate_data_scaled_C %>%
  left_join(C_soil_with_CN %>% select(x,y,c,n), by=c("x","y"))

# Define soil variable names using actual dataset column names
soil_vars <- c("lbc_1","lb_ceq","p_h_2","ca","k","mg","mn","p","zn","c","n")

# Define covariates by removing coordinates + soil variables
covariates <- setdiff(names(soil_SP_full), c("x","y", soil_vars))

# Convert to sf projected
soil_sf_SP <- st_as_sf(soil_SP_full, coords = c("x","y"), crs = 4326) %>% st_transform(32617)
soil_sf_C  <- st_as_sf(soil_C_full, coords = c("x","y"), crs = 4326) %>% st_transform(32617)
```

### UMAP test

```{r}
library(umap)
# Prepare data for UMAP (only soil variables, no coordinates)
soil_umap_SP <- soil_sf_SP %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  select(all_of(soil_vars)) %>%
  drop_na()

soil_umap_C <- soil_sf_C %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  select(all_of(soil_vars)) %>%
  drop_na()

# Run UMAP separately on SP and Composite datasets
set.seed(626)  # for reproducibility
umap_SP <- umap(soil_umap_SP)
umap_C <- umap(soil_umap_C)

#plot UMAP results
umap_df_SP <- as.data.frame(umap_SP$layout) %>% mutate(dataset = "Single Point")
umap_df_C <- as.data.frame(umap_C$layout) %>% mutate(dataset = "Composite")
umap_df <- bind_rows(umap_df_SP, umap_df_C)
ggplot(umap_df, aes(x = V1, y = V2, color = dataset)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7) +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  labs(title = "UMAP of Soil Nutrient Profiles",
       x = "UMAP Dimension 1", y = "UMAP Dimension 2", color = "Dataset") +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5))

#cluster:
library(dbscan)
set.seed(626)
dbscan_SP <- dbscan(umap_SP$layout, eps = 0.5, minPts = 5)
dbscan_C  <- dbscan(umap_C$layout, eps = 0.5, minPts = 5)
umap_df_SP$cluster <- as.factor(dbscan_SP$cluster)
umap_df_C$cluster  <- as.factor(dbscan_C$cluster)
ggplot(umap_df_SP, aes(x = V1, y = V2, color = cluster)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7) +
  scale_color_viridis_d() +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  labs(title = "UMAP Clusters of Single Point Soil Nutrient Profiles",
       x = "UMAP Dimension 1", y = "UMAP Dimension 2", color = "Cluster") +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5))

ggplot(umap_df_C, aes(x = V1, y = V2, color = cluster)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7) +
  scale_color_viridis_d() +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  labs(title = "UMAP Clusters of Composite Soil Nutrient Profiles",
       x = "UMAP Dimension 1", y = "UMAP Dimension 2", color = "Cluster") +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5))

## Explore cluster characteristics (e.g., mean nutrient values per cluster)
cluster_summary_SP <- soil_umap_SP %>%
  mutate(cluster = as.factor(dbscan_SP$cluster)) %>%
  group_by(cluster) %>%
  summarise(across(all_of(soil_vars), mean, na.rm = TRUE))
cluster_summary_C <- soil_umap_C %>%
  mutate(cluster = as.factor(dbscan_C$cluster)) %>%
  group_by(cluster) %>%
  summarise(across(all_of(soil_vars), mean, na.rm = TRUE))  
  
print(cluster_summary_SP)
print(cluster_summary_C)

## Note: UMAP and clustering results can be sensitive to parameters (e.g., eps for DBSCAN), so you may want to experiment with those for better separation or more meaningful clusters.
```

### Plot Composite vs Single Point with Outlier Labels

```{r, warning=FALSE}

# 1) Select only nutrient columns + coordinates
SP_vals <- soil_SP_full %>% select(x, y, all_of(soil_vars)) %>% mutate(dataset = "SP")
C_vals  <- soil_C_full %>% select(x, y, all_of(soil_vars)) %>% mutate(dataset = "Composite")

# 2) Combine and reshape to long format
soil_long <- bind_rows(SP_vals, C_vals) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = all_of(soil_vars), names_to = "variable", values_to = "value")

# 3) Pivot wide: SP vs Composite in one row per point and nutrient
soil_wide <- soil_long %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = dataset, values_from = value) %>%
  drop_na(SP, Composite)   # keeps only nutrients where both exist

  
# --- Attach PointLabel to merged dataset ---
# We join from SP_soil_with_CN since PointLabel is stable there
soil_wide_loc <- soil_wide %>%
  left_join(SP_soil_with_CN %>% select(x, y, PointLabel), by = c("x","y"))

# If you want cleaner facet labels again:
soil_wide_loc <- soil_wide_loc %>%
  mutate(variable = recode(variable,
                           "lbc_1" = "LBC1",
                           "lb_ceq" = "LBCeq",
                           "p_h_2" = "pH",
                           "ca" = "Ca",
                           "k" = "K",
                           "mg" = "Mg",
                           "mn" = "Mn",
                           "p" = "P",
                           "zn" = "Zn",
                           "c" = "C",
                           "n" = "N"))
# --- Compute residuals and identify outliers ---
soil_outliers <- soil_wide_loc %>%
  group_by(variable) %>%
  mutate(
    residual = SP - Composite,
    z = (residual - mean(residual, na.rm = TRUE)) / sd(residual, na.rm = TRUE),
    outlier = abs(z) > 2   # threshold
  )

# ✔ Check how many outliers per nutrient (optional)
soil_outliers %>% count(variable, outlier)

soil_no_outliers <- soil_outliers %>%
  filter(outlier == FALSE)

# --- Plot with 1:1 line and label only outliers ---
ggplot(soil_outliers, aes(x = Composite, y = SP)) +
  geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "red", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, color = "black", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_text_repel(
    data = ~ dplyr::filter(.x, outlier == TRUE),
    aes(label = PointLabel),
    size = 2,
    fontface = "bold",
    max.overlaps = Inf,
    min.segment.length = 0
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ variable, scales = "free") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  labs(
    title = "Composite vs Single Point with Outlier Labels",
    x = "Composite",
    y = "Single Point"
  ) +
  theme(strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"))
```

### Plot without outliers and R² values

```{r, warning=FALSE}

# --- Compute R² for each nutrient ---
r2_labels <- soil_no_outliers %>%
  filter(!is.na(SP), !is.na(Composite), !is.na(variable)) %>%
  group_by(variable) %>%
  summarise(
    r2 = cor(SP, Composite, use = "complete.obs")^2,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(label = paste0("R² = ", round(r2, 2)))

# --- Remove any NA variables before plotting ---
soil_no_outliers <- soil_no_outliers %>%
  filter(!is.na(variable), variable != "NA")

# --- Ensure custom facet order ---
var_order <- c("pH", "Ca", "K", "Mg", "Mn", "P", "Zn", "C", "N")
soil_no_outliers$variable <- factor(soil_no_outliers$variable, levels = var_order)
r2_labels$variable <- factor(r2_labels$variable, levels = var_order)

# --- Plot ---
ggplot(soil_no_outliers, aes(x = Composite, y = SP)) +
  geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 0.7, color = "#4C72B0") +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed",
              color = "red", linewidth = 0.9) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, color = "black", linewidth = 0.9) +
  geom_text(
    data = r2_labels,
    aes(x = -Inf, y = Inf, label = label),
    hjust = -0.1, vjust = 1.4,
    size = 3.3, fontface = "bold"
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ variable, scales = "free", ncol = 3) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  labs(
    title = "Composite vs Single Point Nutrient Values",
    x = "Composite (ppm)",
    y = "Single Point (ppm)"
  ) +
  theme(
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5)
  )
```

### Spatial Bootstrapping and Model Comparison

```{r, warning=FALSE}

# --- Spatial blocking function ---
generate_spatial_bootstrap_block <- function(sf_data,
                                             n_boot = 50,
                                             train_frac = 0.7,
                                             theRange = 50,     # in meters; adjust based on variogram range
                                             n_folds = 5,       # number of spatial blocks
                                             seed = 123) {
  set.seed(seed)

  # Run blockCV spatial blocking to assign folds based on variogram range
  sb <- spatialBlock(speciesData = sf_data,
                     theRange = theRange,       # block size = variogram range
                     k = n_folds,               # number of folds (blocks)
                     selection = "random",      # random assignment of folds
                     showBlocks = FALSE,
                     progress = FALSE)

  # Extract fold assignments
  sf_data$fold <- sb$foldID

  # --- Build list of bootstrapped train/test splits ---
  boot_list <- vector("list", n_boot)
  for (i in seq_len(n_boot)) {
    # randomly pick some folds for training (e.g., 70%)
    n_train_folds <- ceiling(train_frac * n_folds)
    train_folds <- sample(unique(sf_data$fold), n_train_folds)

    df <- sf_data %>%
      mutate(set = ifelse(fold %in% train_folds, "train", "test"))

    boot_list[[i]] <- df
  }

  return(boot_list)
}


# --- Safe R² function ---
safe_cor2 <- function(x, y){
  if(length(x)==0 || length(y)==0) return(NA)
  if(all(is.na(x)) || all(is.na(y))) return(NA)
  cor(x, y, use="complete.obs")^2
}
  #uses correlation with complete.obs to avoid NA issues... but I am not sure if this is the best way to handle it.

# --- Generate bootstraps ---
# Estimate an average variogram range first if you have it
# e.g., from your variogram fits:
# mean_range <- mean(fit_variograms$range, na.rm = TRUE)
# Otherwise start with 50 m as a field-scale approximation

boot_SP <- generate_spatial_bootstrap_block(soil_sf_SP,
                                            n_boot = 50,
                                            train_frac = 0.7,
                                            theRange = 50,
                                            n_folds = 5)

boot_C  <- generate_spatial_bootstrap_block(soil_sf_C,
                                            n_boot = 50,
                                            train_frac = 0.7,
                                            theRange = 50,
                                            n_folds = 5)


# --- Random Forest function ---
run_RF <- function(boot_list, covariates, soil_vars){
  results <- list()
  for(var in soil_vars){
    boot_results <- map(boot_list, function(df){
      train_df <- st_drop_geometry(df %>% filter(set=="train")) %>% select(all_of(c(covariates,var))) %>% na.omit()
      test_df  <- st_drop_geometry(df %>% filter(set=="test")) %>% select(all_of(c(covariates,var))) %>% na.omit()
      if(nrow(train_df) < 5 | nrow(test_df) < 5) return(list(RMSE=NA,R2=NA))
      rf_model <- randomForest(x = train_df[,covariates], y = train_df[[var]], ntree = 500)
      pred <- predict(rf_model, newdata = test_df[,covariates])
      list(model = rf_model, pred = pred,
           RMSE = sqrt(mean((pred - test_df[[var]])^2)),
           R2 = safe_cor2(pred, test_df[[var]]))
    })
    results[[var]] <- boot_results
  }
  return(results)
}

# --- Ordinary Kriging function with fallback ---
# --- Ordinary Kriging function with fallback (always returns R² even if only nugget) ---
run_OK_safe <- function(boot_list, soil_vars) {
  results <- list()

  for (var in soil_vars) {
    boot_results <- map(boot_list, function(df) {
      train_sf <- df %>% filter(set == "train")
      test_sf  <- df %>% filter(set == "test")

      train_vals <- train_sf[[var]]
      test_vals  <- test_sf[[var]]

      # --- skip if too few usable data points ---
      if (all(is.na(train_vals)) || length(unique(train_vals)) <= 1) {
        pred <- rep(mean(train_vals, na.rm = TRUE), nrow(test_sf))
        rmse <- sqrt(mean((pred - test_vals)^2, na.rm = TRUE))
        r2   <- ifelse(var(pred, na.rm = TRUE) > 0 && var(test_vals, na.rm = TRUE) > 0,
                       suppressWarnings(cor(pred, test_vals, use = "complete.obs")^2),
                       0)
        return(list(pred = pred, RMSE = rmse, R2 = r2))
      }

      # --- variogram and model fit (fallback to nugget if needed) ---
      vgm_model <- tryCatch({
        v_emp <- variogram(as.formula(paste(var, "~ 1")), train_sf)
        fit.variogram(v_emp, vgm(psill = var(train_vals, na.rm = TRUE),
                                 model = "Exp",
                                 nugget = 0.1,
                                 range = max(v_emp$dist, na.rm = TRUE)/3))
      }, error = function(e) NULL)

      if (is.null(vgm_model)) {
        vgm_model <- vgm(psill = var(train_vals, na.rm = TRUE),
                         model = "Nug", nugget = 0.1)
      }

      # --- try kriging prediction ---
      ok_pred <- tryCatch({
        krige(as.formula(paste(var, "~ 1")), train_sf, test_sf, model = vgm_model)
      }, error = function(e) NULL)

      # --- fallback if krige fails ---
      pred <- if (!is.null(ok_pred) && "var1.pred" %in% names(ok_pred)) {
        ok_pred$var1.pred
      } else {
        rep(mean(train_vals, na.rm = TRUE), nrow(test_sf))
      }

      # --- safe metrics (handles no complete pairs) ---
      rmse <- sqrt(mean((pred - test_vals)^2, na.rm = TRUE))
      r2 <- tryCatch({
        if (var(pred, na.rm = TRUE) == 0 || var(test_vals, na.rm = TRUE) == 0) 0
        else cor(pred, test_vals, use = "complete.obs")^2
      }, error = function(e) 0)

      list(pred = pred, RMSE = rmse, R2 = r2)
    })
    results[[var]] <- boot_results
  }
  return(results)
}


# --- Regression Kriging function with fallback ---
run_RK_safe <- function(boot_list, covariates, soil_vars){
  results <- list()
  for(var in soil_vars){
    boot_results <- map(boot_list, function(df){
      train_sf <- df %>% filter(set=="train")
      test_sf  <- df %>% filter(set=="test")
      
      # Remove rows with NA in predictors or target
      train_df <- st_drop_geometry(train_sf) %>% select(all_of(c(covariates,var))) %>% na.omit()
      test_df  <- st_drop_geometry(test_sf) %>% select(all_of(c(covariates,var))) %>% na.omit()
      
      # Skip if too few points
      if(nrow(train_df)<5 | nrow(test_df)<5) return(list(RMSE=NA,R2=NA))
      
      # Match sf objects to filtered rows
      train_sf <- train_sf[rownames(train_df), ]
      test_sf  <- test_sf[rownames(test_df), ]
      
      # Trend model (RF)
      rf_model <- randomForest(x=train_df[,covariates], y=train_df[[var]], ntree=500)
      trend_train <- predict(rf_model, newdata=train_df[,covariates])
      trend_test  <- predict(rf_model, newdata=test_df[,covariates])
      
      # Residuals
      residuals_train <- train_df[[var]] - trend_train
      
      # Make a new sf object with only the filtered residuals
      train_res_sf <- train_sf %>% mutate(residuals=residuals_train)
      
      # Variogram for residuals
      vgm_model <- tryCatch(
        variogram(residuals~1, train_res_sf) %>%
          fit.variogram(vgm(psill=var(residuals_train, na.rm=TRUE), model="Exp", nugget=0.1, range=100)),
        error=function(e) NULL
      )
      if(is.null(vgm_model)) vgm_model <- vgm(psill=var(residuals_train, na.rm=TRUE), model="Exp", nugget=0.1, range=100)
      
      # Krige residuals
      rk_pred <- tryCatch(
        krige(residuals~1, train_res_sf, test_sf, model=vgm_model),
        error=function(e) NULL
      )
      # fallback if krige fails or lengths mismatch
      if(is.null(rk_pred) || length(rk_pred$var1.pred)!=nrow(test_sf)){
        rk_pred <- data.frame(var1.pred=rep(0,nrow(test_sf)))
      }
      
      # Combine trend + residuals
      final_pred <- trend_test + rk_pred$var1.pred
      rmse <- sqrt(mean((final_pred - test_df[[var]])^2, na.rm=TRUE))
      r2   <- safe_cor2(final_pred, test_df[[var]])
      
      list(RMSE=rmse, R2=r2)
    })
    results[[var]] <- boot_results
  }
  return(results)
}

# --- Run all methods ---
RF_results_SP <- run_RF(boot_SP, covariates, soil_vars)
RF_results_C  <- run_RF(boot_C, covariates, soil_vars)
OK_results_SP <- run_OK_safe(boot_SP, soil_vars)
OK_results_C  <- run_OK_safe(boot_C, soil_vars)
RK_results_SP <- run_RK_safe(boot_SP, covariates, soil_vars)
RK_results_C  <- run_RK_safe(boot_C, covariates, soil_vars)

# --- Function to extract metrics ---
extract_metrics <- function(results_list, dataset_name){
  map_dfr(names(results_list), function(var){
    res <- results_list[[var]]
    tibble(variable=var, RMSE=map_dbl(res,"RMSE"), R2=map_dbl(res,"R2"))
  }) %>% mutate(dataset=dataset_name)
}

rf_metrics_all <- bind_rows(extract_metrics(RF_results_SP,"Single Point"),
                            extract_metrics(RF_results_C,"Composite"))
ok_metrics_all <- bind_rows(extract_metrics(OK_results_SP,"Single Point"),
                            extract_metrics(OK_results_C,"Composite"))
rk_metrics_all <- bind_rows(extract_metrics(RK_results_SP,"Single Point"),
                            extract_metrics(RK_results_C,"Composite"))

# --- Combine all for plotting ---
combined_metrics <- bind_rows(rf_metrics_all %>% mutate(method="RF"),
                              ok_metrics_all %>% mutate(method="OK"),
                              rk_metrics_all %>% mutate(method="RK")) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols=c(RMSE,R2), names_to="metric", values_to="value")

# --- Plot ---

ggplot(combined_metrics, aes(x=variable, y=value, fill=dataset)) +
  geom_violin(trim=FALSE, alpha=0.6) +
  geom_boxplot(width=0.1, position=position_dodge(width=0.9), outlier.shape=NA) +
  theme_minimal(base_size=13) +
  labs(title="Distribution of RMSE and R² across nutrients - All Methods",
       x="Nutrient", y="Value") +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette="Set2") +
  facet_grid(metric~method, scales="free_y")
```

### Metric Extraction Helpers

```{r, warning=FALSE}

safe_cor2 <- function(x,y){
  if(length(x)==0 || length(y)==0) return(NA_real_)
  if(all(is.na(x)) || all(is.na(y))) return(NA_real_)
  cc <- suppressWarnings(cor(x,y,use="complete.obs"))
  if(is.na(cc)) NA_real_ else cc^2
}

# helper to rebuild test observed vector in same order as how predictions were produced in your functions
# df_boot: an sf tibble that has column 'set' with "train"/"test" (like your generate_spatial_bootstrap output)
# var: target variable name
# returns: test_df (data.frame) after the na.omit used in your run functions, plus row_ids to map back to original rows
build_test_df_from_boot <- function(df_boot, var, covariates){
  # df_boot is sf with geometry; use st_drop_geometry in same manner as your run functions
  df <- sf::st_drop_geometry(df_boot)
  test_df_full <- df %>% filter(set == "test") %>% mutate(.orig_row = row_number())
  # select covariates and var and remove rows with NA similarly to run_RF/run_RK
  sel_cols <- c(covariates, var)
  test_sel <- test_df_full %>% select(all_of(sel_cols), .orig_row)
  # na.omit - keep track of original row indices
  complete_idx <- stats::complete.cases(test_sel)
  test_sel2 <- test_sel[complete_idx, , drop = FALSE]
  # test_sel2 has covariates, var and .orig_row
  return(list(test_df = test_sel2, omitted = !complete_idx))
}

# generic function to compute metrics from prediction and observed vectors
compute_metrics_vecs <- function(obs, pred){
  ok <- !is.na(obs) & !is.na(pred)
  n <- sum(ok)
  if(n==0) return(tibble(n = 0, RMSE = NA_real_, MAE = NA_real_, Bias = NA_real_, R2_cor = NA_real_))
  err <- pred[ok] - obs[ok]
  tibble(
    n = n,
    RMSE = sqrt(mean(err^2)),
    MAE = mean(abs(err)),
    Bias = mean(err),
    R2_cor = safe_cor2(obs[ok], pred[ok])
  )
}

# main extractor that returns a list: predictions_long (tibble), per_boot_metrics (tibble)
extract_metrics_for_method <- function(results_list, boot_list, method_name, covariates, soil_vars){
  preds_long <- list()
  per_boot_rows <- list()
  n_nut <- length(soil_vars)
  for(nut in soil_vars){
    res_boots <- results_list[[nut]]
    # iterate boots; results_list[[nut]] should be a list of length n_boot
    for(bi in seq_along(res_boots)){
      res <- res_boots[[bi]]
      boot_sf <- boot_list[[bi]]
      # build test_df in same logic as your functions
      test_build <- build_test_df_from_boot(boot_sf, nut, covariates)
      test_df <- test_build$test_df
      # try to extract pred vector from res (narrow cases)
      pred_vec <- NULL
      obs_vec <- NULL
      # If res already stored pred and maybe observed, prefer them
      if(!is.null(res$pred) && !is.null(res$observed)){
        pred_vec <- res$pred
        obs_vec  <- res$observed
      } else if(!is.null(res$pred) && is.data.frame(test_df) && nrow(test_df) == length(res$pred)){
        # assume ordering matches the test_df after na.omit (this is how your run_RF created pred)
        pred_vec <- res$pred
        obs_vec  <- test_df[[nut]]
      } else if(!is.null(res$model) && inherits(res$model, "randomForest") && is.data.frame(test_df)){
        # RF stored model object; predict fresh on test covariates (should match original pred)
        # ensure columns in test_df align
        predictor_matrix <- test_df[, covariates, drop = FALSE]
        pred_vec <- tryCatch(predict(res$model, newdata = predictor_matrix), error = function(e) NULL)
        obs_vec  <- test_df[[nut]]
      } else {
        # As a fallback: attempt to recompute prediction using simple approach depending on method
        if(method_name == "RF"){
          # try to fit a quick RF on training partition of this boot and predict
          train_df <- sf::st_drop_geometry(boot_sf) %>% filter(set=="train") %>% select(all_of(c(covariates, nut))) %>% na.omit()
          test_df2  <- test_df
          if(nrow(train_df) >= 3 && nrow(test_df2) >= 1){
            rf_mod <- tryCatch(randomForest::randomForest(x = train_df[, covariates, drop = FALSE], y = train_df[[nut]], ntree = 200), error = function(e) NULL)
            if(!is.null(rf_mod)){
              pred_vec <- tryCatch(predict(rf_mod, newdata = test_df2[, covariates, drop = FALSE]), error = function(e) NULL)
              obs_vec  <- test_df2[[nut]]
            }
          }
        } else if(method_name == "OK"){
          # run ordinary kriging on this boot
          train_sf <- boot_sf %>% filter(set=="train")
          test_sf  <- boot_sf %>% filter(set=="test")
          # keep only rows with non-NA target
          if(sum(!is.na(train_sf[[nut]])) >= 3 && nrow(test_sf) >= 1){
            # ensure train_sf/test_sf are sf objects with projected CRS (your boot list used sf transformed earlier)
            v_emp <- tryCatch(variogram(as.formula(paste(nut,"~1")), train_sf), error = function(e) NULL)
            vgm_model <- tryCatch(fit.variogram(v_emp, model = vgm(psill = var(train_sf[[nut]], na.rm=TRUE), model = "Exp", nugget = 0.1, range = max(v_emp$dist, na.rm=TRUE)/3)), error = function(e) NULL)
            if(is.null(vgm_model)) vgm_model <- tryCatch(vgm(psill = var(train_sf[[nut]], na.rm=TRUE), model="Exp", nugget=0.1, range=100), error = function(e) NULL)
            ok_pred <- tryCatch(krige(as.formula(paste(nut,"~1")), train_sf, test_sf, model = vgm_model), error = function(e) NULL)
            if(!is.null(ok_pred) && "var1.pred" %in% names(ok_pred)){
              pred_vec <- ok_pred$var1.pred
              # align obs: remove NA rows similarly to how you computed predictions
              # build test_df2 as earlier
              obs_build <- build_test_df_from_boot(boot_sf, nut, covariates)
              obs_vec <- obs_build$test_df[[nut]]
            }
          }
        } else if(method_name == "RK"){
          # recompute RK: RF trend on train + krige residuals
          train_df <- sf::st_drop_geometry(boot_sf) %>% filter(set=="train") %>% select(all_of(c(covariates, nut))) %>% na.omit()
          test_df2  <- test_df
          if(nrow(train_df) >= 5 && nrow(test_df2) >= 1){
            train_sf_filtered <- boot_sf %>% filter(set=="train")
            # align train_sf_filtered to non-NA rows in train_df
            # We assume original row ordering remains consistent enough; best to join by coordinates if needed
            # Fit RF trend
            rf_mod <- tryCatch(randomForest::randomForest(x = train_df[, covariates, drop = FALSE], y = train_df[[nut]], ntree = 200), error = function(e) NULL)
            if(!is.null(rf_mod)){
              trend_train <- predict(rf_mod, newdata = train_df[, covariates, drop = FALSE])
              resid_train <- train_df[[nut]] - trend_train
              # attach residuals to train_sf_filtered: subset to rows matching train_df by coordinates
              # This is a heuristic mapping: select rows in train_sf_filtered with values matching train_df rows
              # Safer approach: if train_df had rownames carrying original row IDs, use that. If not, we proceed best-effort.
              train_sf_filtered2 <- train_sf_filtered
              # assign residuals in order of non-NA rows
              non_na_idx <- which(!is.na(train_sf_filtered2[[nut]]))
              assign_len <- min(length(resid_train), length(non_na_idx))
              if(assign_len > 0) train_sf_filtered2$resid <- NA_real_
              train_sf_filtered2$resid[non_na_idx[1:assign_len]] <- resid_train[1:assign_len]
              # fit variogram and krige residuals
              v_emp_r <- tryCatch(variogram(resid~1, train_sf_filtered2), error = function(e) NULL)
              vgm_model <- tryCatch(fit.variogram(v_emp_r, model = vgm(psill = var(resid_train, na.rm=TRUE), model="Exp", nugget=0.1, range = max(v_emp_r$dist, na.rm=TRUE)/3)), error = function(e) NULL)
              if(is.null(vgm_model)) vgm_model <- tryCatch(vgm(psill = var(resid_train, na.rm=TRUE), model="Exp", nugget=0.1, range=100), error = function(e) NULL)
              test_sf <- boot_sf %>% filter(set=="test")
              kr_res <- tryCatch(krige(resid~1, train_sf_filtered2, test_sf, model = vgm_model), error = function(e) NULL)
              if(!is.null(kr_res) && "var1.pred" %in% names(kr_res)){
                trend_test <- predict(rf_mod, newdata = test_df2[, covariates, drop = FALSE])
                pred_vec <- trend_test + kr_res$var1.pred
                obs_vec <- test_df2[[nut]]
              }
            }
          }
        }
      } # end fallback block

      # Now compute metrics for this boot if pred_vec and obs_vec exist; align lengths
      if(!is.null(pred_vec) && !is.null(obs_vec) && length(pred_vec) == length(obs_vec)){
        metrics_row <- compute_metrics_vecs(obs_vec, pred_vec)
        per_boot_rows[[length(per_boot_rows) + 1]] <- tibble(
          nutrient = nut, method = method_name, boot = bi,
          n_test = metrics_row$n, RMSE = metrics_row$RMSE, MAE = metrics_row$MAE, Bias = metrics_row$Bias, R2_cor = metrics_row$R2_cor
        )
        # store predictions with coordinates by mapping test_df .orig_row back to original geometry from boot_sf
        # test_df came from build_test_df_from_boot and has .orig_row -> position within test partition
        # We will include coordinates from boot_sf for the test rows used
        # Rebuild a matching sf test subset (after na.omit): 
        # Use the same logic as in build_test_df_from_boot to identify which test rows used
        test_sf_full <- boot_sf %>% filter(set == "test")
        # find rows in test_sf_full that correspond to the kept ones: use complete.cases on selected columns
        test_sel_full <- sf::st_drop_geometry(test_sf_full)[, c(covariates, nut), drop = FALSE]
        keep_mask <- stats::complete.cases(test_sel_full)
        if(sum(keep_mask) > 0){
          test_sf_kept <- test_sf_full[keep_mask, ]
          # Now ensure lengths match pred_vec
          if(nrow(test_sf_kept) == length(pred_vec)){
            preds_long[[length(preds_long) + 1]] <- tibble(
              nutrient = nut, method = method_name, boot = bi,
              x = as.numeric(sf::st_coordinates(test_sf_kept)[,1]),
              y = as.numeric(sf::st_coordinates(test_sf_kept)[,2]),
              observed = obs_vec,
              predicted = pred_vec
            )
          } else {
            # fallback: store without coords
            preds_long[[length(preds_long) + 1]] <- tibble(
              nutrient = nut, method = method_name, boot = bi,
              x = NA_real_, y = NA_real_,
              observed = obs_vec,
              predicted = pred_vec
            )
          }
        } else {
          preds_long[[length(preds_long) + 1]] <- tibble(
            nutrient = nut, method = method_name, boot = bi,
            x = NA_real_, y = NA_real_,
            observed = obs_vec,
            predicted = pred_vec
          )
        }
      } else {
        # record NA metrics if we couldn't get predictions
        per_boot_rows[[length(per_boot_rows) + 1]] <- tibble(
          nutrient = nut, method = method_name, boot = bi, n_test = 0,
          RMSE = NA_real_, MAE = NA_real_, Bias = NA_real_, R2_cor = NA_real_
        )
      }

    } # end boots loop
  } # end nutrients loop

  per_boot_metrics <- bind_rows(per_boot_rows)
  predictions_long <- bind_rows(preds_long)
  list(predictions_long = predictions_long, per_boot_metrics = per_boot_metrics)
}
#SP:
# Run extraction for Single Point boots (boot_SP) and Composite boots (boot_C)
message("Extracting metrics for Single Point (SP) boots...")

  group_by(nutrient, method) %>%
  summarize(
    n_total = sum(!is.na(observed) & !is.na(predicted)),
    pooled_RMSE = ifelse(n_total==0, NA_real_, sqrt(mean((observed - predicted)^2, na.rm=TRUE))),

    pooled_R2_cor = ifelse(n_total <= 1, NA_real_, {cc <- suppressWarnings(cor(observed, predicted, use="complete.obs")); ifelse(is.na(cc), NA_real_, cc^2)}),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

### Statistical Testing Between Methods

```{r, warning=FALSE}
prepare_paired_data <- function(results_list, dataset_name, method_name){
  map_dfr(names(results_list), function(var){
    res <- results_list[[var]]
    tibble(variable=var, RMSE=map_dbl(res,"RMSE"), R2=map_dbl(res,"R2")) %>%
      mutate(dataset=dataset_name, method=method_name)
  })
}
rf_paired <- bind_rows(prepare_paired_data(RF_results_SP,"Single Point","RF"),
                       prepare_paired_data(RF_results_C,"Composite","RF"))
ok_paired <- bind_rows(prepare_paired_data(OK_results_SP,"Single Point","OK"),
                       prepare_paired_data(OK_results_C,"Composite","OK"))
rk_paired <- bind_rows(prepare_paired_data(RK_results_SP,"Single Point","RK"),
                       prepare_paired_data(RK_results_C,"Composite","RK"))

all_paired <- bind_rows(rf_paired, ok_paired, rk_paired)

# Paired tests between methods for each variable and dataset
test_results <- map_dfr(unique(all_paired$variable), function(var){
  map_dfr(unique(all_paired$dataset), function(ds){
    subset_data <- all_paired %>% filter(variable==var, dataset==ds)
    rf_data <- subset_data %>% filter(method=="RF")
    ok_data <- subset_data %>% filter(method=="OK")
    rk_data <- subset_data %>% filter(method=="RK")
    # RF vs OK
    rf_ok_test <- wilcox.test(rf_data$R2, ok_data$R2, paired=TRUE, alternative="two.sided")
    # RF vs RK
    rf_rk_test <- wilcox.test(rf_data$R2, rk_data$R2, paired=TRUE, alternative="two.sided")
    # OK vs RK
    ok_rk_test <- wilcox.test(ok_data$R2, rk_data$R2, paired=TRUE, alternative="two.sided")
    tibble(variable=var, dataset=ds,
           RF_vs_OK_p=rf_ok_test$p.value,
           RF_vs_RK_p=rf_rk_test$p.value,
           OK_vs_RK_p=ok_rk_test$p.value)
  })
})
#create formatted results with significance <0.05 marked with *
formatted_results <- test_results %>%
  #sort by lowest p-value in RF_vs_OK
  arrange(RF_vs_OK_p) %>%
  mutate(RF_vs_OK = ifelse(RF_vs_OK_p < 0.05, paste0(round(RF_vs_OK_p,4), "*"), round(RF_vs_OK_p,4)),
         RF_vs_RK = ifelse(RF_vs_RK_p < 0.05, paste0(round(RF_vs_RK_p,4), "*"), round(RF_vs_RK_p,4)),
         OK_vs_RK = ifelse(OK_vs_RK_p < 0.05, paste0(round(OK_vs_RK_p,4), "*"), round(OK_vs_RK_p,4))) %>%
  select(variable, dataset, RF_vs_OK, RF_vs_RK, OK_vs_RK)
formatted_results
```
### Covariate Name Matching

```{r}


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 1) Define soil vars we do NOT want as predictors
# ------------------------------------------------------------
soil_vars_all <- c("lbc_1","lb_ceq","p_h_2","ca","k","mg","mn","p","zn","c","n")

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 2) Build normalized-name matching between points and raster
# ------------------------------------------------------------
norm_name <- function(x){
  x %>%
    tolower() %>%
    str_replace_all("[^a-z0-9]+", "_") %>%  # collapse punctuation/spaces to _
    str_replace_all("_+", "_") %>%          # remove repeats
    str_replace_all("^_|_$", "")            # trim ends
}

stack_names <- names(covariate_stack)
sp_names <- names(st_drop_geometry(soil_sf_SP))

# candidates on points side = everything except soil vars + geometry-ish columns
sp_candidates <- setdiff(sp_names, c(soil_vars_all, "geometry", "set", "fold"))

# make lookup tables
stack_tbl <- tibble(stack = stack_names, stack_norm = norm_name(stack_names))
sp_tbl    <- tibble(sp = sp_candidates, sp_norm = norm_name(sp_candidates))

# join by normalized name
map_tbl <- sp_tbl %>%
  left_join(stack_tbl, by = c("sp_norm" = "stack_norm"))

# which point cols did not match any raster layer?
unmatched_sp <- map_tbl %>% filter(is.na(stack)) %>% pull(sp)

# which raster layers were not matched by any point col?
matched_stack <- na.omit(map_tbl$stack) %>% unique()
unmatched_stack <- setdiff(stack_names, matched_stack)

cat("Point covariate cols:", length(sp_candidates), "\n")
cat("Raster layers:", length(stack_names), "\n")
cat("Matched:", length(matched_stack), "\n")
cat("UNmatched point cols:", length(unmatched_sp), "\n")
cat("UNmatched raster layers:", length(unmatched_stack), "\n")

if (length(unmatched_sp) > 0) {
  cat("\n--- Unmatched point columns (first 30) ---\n")
  print(head(unmatched_sp, 30))
}
if (length(unmatched_stack) > 0) {
  cat("\n--- Unmatched raster layers (first 30) ---\n")
  print(head(unmatched_stack, 30))
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 3) Actually rename point columns to match raster stack names
#    Only for those with a match, and avoid collisions.
# ------------------------------------------------------------
rename_vec <- map_tbl %>%
  filter(!is.na(stack)) %>%
  distinct(sp, stack) %>%
  # if multiple sp map to same stack (rare), keep first
  group_by(stack) %>% slice(1) %>% ungroup() %>%
  { setNames(.$stack, .$sp) }   # old -> new mapping (dplyr::rename expects new=old, so we’ll do base rename)

# base R rename for data.frames: names(df)[match(old, names(df))] <- new
apply_rename <- function(sf_obj, rename_vec){
  nm <- names(sf_obj)
  olds <- names(rename_vec)
  idx <- match(olds, nm)
  hit <- !is.na(idx)
  nm[idx[hit]] <- rename_vec[hit]
  names(sf_obj) <- nm
  sf_obj
}

soil_sf_SP <- apply_rename(soil_sf_SP, rename_vec)
soil_sf_C  <- apply_rename(soil_sf_C,  rename_vec)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 4) Now you can use ALL raster layers as covariates
#    (except soil variables if they exist as layers)
# ------------------------------------------------------------
covariates <- setdiff(names(covariate_stack), soil_vars_all)

# Final sanity
missing_now_SP <- setdiff(covariates, names(st_drop_geometry(soil_sf_SP)))
missing_now_C  <- setdiff(covariates, names(st_drop_geometry(soil_sf_C)))

cat("\nAfter renaming:\n")
cat("Missing in SP:", length(missing_now_SP), "\n")
cat("Missing in C :", length(missing_now_C), "\n")

if (length(missing_now_SP) > 0) {
  cat("\n--- Still missing in SP (first 30) ---\n")
  print(head(missing_now_SP, 30))
}

# Optional: reorder stack to covariates
covariate_stack <- covariate_stack[[covariates]]

```
### Final Map Prediction Using Best Boot Models

```{r}
# ============================================================
# Best-boot selection + FINAL mapping (RF / OK / RK) in ONE chunk
# ============================================================

# libs assumed loaded: terra, sf, dplyr, gstat, randomForest

# -----------------------------
# 0) Soil vars to map
# -----------------------------
soil_vars_to_map <- c("ca","k","mg","mn","p","zn","c","n","p_h_2")

# -----------------------------
# 1) Best boot table (high R2, low RMSE) — for reporting only
# -----------------------------
per_boot_metrics_all <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  per_boot_metrics_SP %>% dplyr::mutate(dataset = "SP"),
  per_boot_metrics_C  %>% dplyr::mutate(dataset = "C")
) %>%
  dplyr::rename(R2 = R2_cor) %>%
  dplyr::filter(is.finite(RMSE), is.finite(R2))

best_boot_tbl <- per_boot_metrics_all %>%
  dplyr::filter(nutrient %in% soil_vars_to_map, method %in% c("RF","RK","OK")) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(dataset, method, nutrient) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    zR2   = as.numeric(scale(R2)),
    zRMSE = as.numeric(scale(RMSE)),
    score = zR2 - zRMSE
  ) %>%
  dplyr::slice_max(order_by = score, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()

print(best_boot_tbl)

# -----------------------------
# 2) Covariates = raster stack names minus soil vars
# -----------------------------
soil_vars_all <- c("lbc_1","lb_ceq","p_h_2","ca","k","mg","mn","p","zn","c","n")
covariates <- setdiff(names(covariate_stack), soil_vars_all)

stopifnot(all(covariates %in% names(sf::st_drop_geometry(soil_sf_SP))))
stopifnot(all(covariates %in% names(sf::st_drop_geometry(soil_sf_C))))

template_r <- covariate_stack[[1]]

# -----------------------------
# 3) Helpers
# -----------------------------
align_sf_to_raster <- function(soil_sf, r){
  crs_r <- terra::crs(r, proj = TRUE)
  if (is.na(crs_r) || crs_r == "") stop("Raster has no CRS.")
  sf::st_transform(soil_sf, crs_r)
}

# RF final map (safe predict)
predict_RF_final <- function(soil_sf, covariate_stack, covariates, nutrient, ntree = 500) {

  df <- sf::st_drop_geometry(soil_sf) %>%
    dplyr::select(dplyr::all_of(c(covariates, nutrient))) %>%
    stats::na.omit()

  if (nrow(df) < 10) stop("Too few training rows for RF: ", nutrient)

  rf_mod <- randomForest::randomForest(
    x = df[, covariates, drop = FALSE],
    y = df[[nutrient]],
    ntree = ntree
  )

  pred_df <- terra::as.data.frame(covariate_stack[[covariates]], cells = TRUE, na.rm = FALSE)
  X <- pred_df[, covariates, drop = FALSE]
  keep <- stats::complete.cases(X)

  pred <- rep(NA_real_, nrow(pred_df))
  pred[keep] <- as.numeric(predict(rf_mod, newdata = as.data.frame(X[keep, , drop = FALSE])))

  out <- covariate_stack[[1]]
  vals <- rep(NA_real_, terra::ncell(out))
  vals[pred_df$cell] <- pred
  terra::values(out) <- vals
  out
}

# OK final map (CRS-safe + cell-index assignment)
predict_OK_final <- function(soil_sf, template_raster, nutrient, debug = TRUE) {

  # align to raster CRS
  train_sf <- sf::st_transform(soil_sf, terra::crs(template_raster, proj = TRUE))

  # drop NA response rows (CRITICAL for gstat)
  train_sf <- train_sf %>% dplyr::filter(!is.na(.data[[nutrient]]))

  if (debug) {
    cat("\n[OK DEBUG] nutrient:", nutrient, "\n")
    cat("  n rows (non-NA):", nrow(train_sf), "\n")
    cat("  unique values:", length(unique(train_sf[[nutrient]])), "\n")
    cat("  CRS:", sf::st_crs(train_sf)$wkt %>% substr(1, 60), "...\n")
  }

  vals <- train_sf[[nutrient]]
  if (length(vals) < 10 || length(unique(vals)) < 2)
    stop("Too few usable (non-NA) points for OK: ", nutrient)

  # empirical variogram
  v_emp <- tryCatch(
    gstat::variogram(stats::as.formula(paste(nutrient, "~ 1")), train_sf),
    error = function(e) stop("Variogram failed for OK ", nutrient, ": ", e$message)
  )

  if (nrow(v_emp) < 3) stop("Variogram has too few bins for OK: ", nutrient)

  init_range <- max(v_emp$dist, na.rm = TRUE) / 3
  init_psill <- stats::var(vals, na.rm = TRUE)

  v_fit <- tryCatch(
    gstat::fit.variogram(
      v_emp,
      gstat::vgm(psill = init_psill, model = "Exp",
                 nugget = 0.1 * init_psill, range = init_range)
    ),
    error = function(e) gstat::vgm(psill = init_psill, model = "Nug", nugget = 0.1 * init_psill)
  )

  # grid WITH cell index (prevents ordering artifacts)
  grid_df <- terra::as.data.frame(template_raster, cells = TRUE, xy = TRUE, na.rm = FALSE) %>%
    dplyr::select(cell, x, y)

  grd_sf <- sf::st_as_sf(
    grid_df, coords = c("x","y"),
    crs = terra::crs(template_raster, proj = TRUE),
    remove = FALSE
  )

  ok <- tryCatch(
    gstat::krige(stats::as.formula(paste(nutrient, "~ 1")), train_sf, grd_sf, model = v_fit),
    error = function(e) stop("Kriging failed for OK ", nutrient, ": ", e$message)
  )

  out <- template_raster
  vals_out <- rep(NA_real_, terra::ncell(out))
  vals_out[grid_df$cell] <- ok$var1.pred
  terra::values(out) <- vals_out

  out
}


# RK final map (RF trend + kriged residuals; CRS-safe + cell-index assignment)
predict_RK_final <- function(soil_sf, covariate_stack, covariates, nutrient, ntree = 500) {

  soil_sf_r <- align_sf_to_raster(soil_sf, covariate_stack[[1]])

  df0 <- sf::st_drop_geometry(soil_sf_r) %>%
    dplyr::select(dplyr::all_of(c(covariates, nutrient))) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(.row_id = dplyr::row_number())

  keep_train <- stats::complete.cases(df0[, c(covariates, nutrient)])
  df <- df0[keep_train, , drop = FALSE]

  if (nrow(df) < 10) stop("Too few training rows for RK: ", nutrient)

  rf_mod <- randomForest::randomForest(
    x = df[, covariates, drop = FALSE],
    y = df[[nutrient]],
    ntree = ntree
  )

  trend_pts <- as.numeric(predict(rf_mod, newdata = df[, covariates, drop = FALSE]))
  resid <- df[[nutrient]] - trend_pts

  soil_sf2 <- soil_sf_r[df$.row_id, ]
  train_res_sf <- soil_sf2 %>% dplyr::mutate(resid = resid)

  v_emp <- tryCatch(gstat::variogram(resid ~ 1, train_res_sf), error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(v_emp) || nrow(v_emp) < 3) {
    message("RK residual variogram failed for ", nutrient, " -> returning RF trend only")
    return(predict_RF_final(soil_sf_r, covariate_stack, covariates, nutrient, ntree = ntree))
  }

  init_range <- max(v_emp$dist, na.rm = TRUE) / 3
  init_psill <- stats::var(resid, na.rm = TRUE)

  v_fit <- tryCatch(
    gstat::fit.variogram(
      v_emp,
      gstat::vgm(psill = init_psill, model = "Exp",
                 nugget = 0.1 * init_psill, range = init_range)
    ),
    error = function(e) gstat::vgm(psill = init_psill, model = "Nug", nugget = 0.1 * init_psill)
  )

  # RF trend raster (safe predict)
  pred_df <- terra::as.data.frame(covariate_stack[[covariates]], cells = TRUE, na.rm = FALSE)
  X <- pred_df[, covariates, drop = FALSE]
  keep <- stats::complete.cases(X)

  trend_pred <- rep(NA_real_, nrow(pred_df))
  trend_pred[keep] <- as.numeric(predict(rf_mod, newdata = as.data.frame(X[keep, , drop = FALSE])))

  trend_r <- covariate_stack[[1]]
  vals_tr <- rep(NA_real_, terra::ncell(trend_r))
  vals_tr[pred_df$cell] <- trend_pred
  terra::values(trend_r) <- vals_tr

  # residual kriging to raster grid (cell-index assignment)
  grid_df <- terra::as.data.frame(trend_r, cells = TRUE, xy = TRUE, na.rm = FALSE) %>%
    dplyr::select(cell, x, y)

  grd_sf <- sf::st_as_sf(grid_df, coords = c("x","y"),
                         crs = terra::crs(trend_r, proj = TRUE),
                         remove = FALSE)

  kr_res <- gstat::krige(resid ~ 1, train_res_sf, grd_sf, model = v_fit)

  res_r <- trend_r
  vals_res <- rep(NA_real_, terra::ncell(res_r))
  vals_res[grid_df$cell] <- kr_res$var1.pred
  terra::values(res_r) <- vals_res

  trend_r + res_r
}

# -----------------------------
# 4) Write FINAL maps (train on all points) for ALL methods
# -----------------------------
out_dir <- "best_boot_maps"
dir.create(out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)

for (ds in c("SP","C")) {

  soil_sf_use <- if (ds == "SP") soil_sf_SP else soil_sf_C

  for (nut in soil_vars_to_map) {

    for (meth in c("RF","OK","RK")) {

      cat("Mapping:", ds, nut, meth, "\n")

      r <- tryCatch({
        if (meth == "RF")      predict_RF_final(soil_sf_use, covariate_stack, covariates, nut)
        else if (meth == "OK") predict_OK_final(soil_sf_use, template_r, nut)
        else                   predict_RK_final(soil_sf_use, covariate_stack, covariates, nut)
      }, error = function(e) {
        message("FAILED: ", ds, " ", nut, " ", meth, " -> ", e$message)
        NULL
      })

      if (!is.null(r)) {
        fn <- file.path(out_dir, sprintf("%s_%s_%s_bestboot.tif", ds, nut, meth))
        terra::writeRaster(r, fn, overwrite = TRUE)
      }
    }
  }
}

cat("Done. Outputs in:", out_dir, "\n")

```

```{r}


# helper: make soil_sf match raster CRS
align_sf_to_raster <- function(soil_sf, r){
  crs_r <- terra::crs(r, proj = TRUE)
  if (is.na(crs_r) || crs_r == "") stop("Raster has no CRS.")
  sf::st_transform(soil_sf, crs_r)
}

# OK final map (CRS-safe + variogram fallback)
predict_OK_final <- function(soil_sf, template_raster, nutrient) {

  # align points to raster CRS
  train_sf <- sf::st_transform(soil_sf, terra::crs(template_raster, proj = TRUE))

  vals <- train_sf[[nutrient]]
  if (sum(!is.na(vals)) < 10 || length(unique(na.omit(vals))) < 2)
    stop("Too few points for OK: ", nutrient)

  # empirical variogram + fit
  v_emp <- gstat::variogram(stats::as.formula(paste(nutrient, "~ 1")), train_sf)

  init_range <- max(v_emp$dist, na.rm = TRUE) / 3
  init_psill <- stats::var(vals, na.rm = TRUE)

  v_fit <- tryCatch(
    gstat::fit.variogram(
      v_emp,
      gstat::vgm(psill = init_psill, model = "Exp",
                 nugget = 0.1 * init_psill, range = init_range)
    ),
    error = function(e) gstat::vgm(psill = init_psill, model = "Nug", nugget = 0.1 * init_psill)
  )

  # build raster grid WITH cell index (this prevents re-ordering artifacts)
  grid_df <- terra::as.data.frame(template_raster, cells = TRUE, xy = TRUE, na.rm = FALSE) |>
    dplyr::select(cell, x, y)

  grd_sf <- sf::st_as_sf(grid_df, coords = c("x","y"),
                         crs = terra::crs(template_raster, proj = TRUE), remove = FALSE)

  ok <- gstat::krige(stats::as.formula(paste(nutrient, "~ 1")),
                     train_sf, grd_sf, model = v_fit)

  # assign by cell index (robust)
  out <- template_raster
  vals_out <- rep(NA_real_, terra::ncell(out))
  vals_out[grid_df$cell] <- ok$var1.pred
  terra::values(out) <- vals_out

  out
}

# RK final map (CRS-safe + robust row alignment)
predict_RK_final <- function(soil_sf, covariate_stack, covariates, nutrient, ntree = 500) {

  # 1) align soil_sf to raster CRS (critical)
  soil_sf_r <- align_sf_to_raster(soil_sf, covariate_stack[[1]])

  # 2) training df (keep row ids for alignment)
  df0 <- sf::st_drop_geometry(soil_sf_r) %>%
    dplyr::select(dplyr::all_of(c(covariates, nutrient))) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(.row_id = dplyr::row_number())

  keep_train <- stats::complete.cases(df0[, c(covariates, nutrient)])
  df <- df0[keep_train, , drop = FALSE]

  if (nrow(df) < 10) stop("Too few training rows for RK: ", nutrient)

  # 3) RF trend on points
  rf_mod <- randomForest::randomForest(
    x = df[, covariates, drop = FALSE],
    y = df[[nutrient]],
    ntree = ntree
  )

  trend_pts <- as.numeric(predict(rf_mod, newdata = df[, covariates, drop = FALSE]))
  resid <- df[[nutrient]] - trend_pts

  # 4) attach residuals back to matching sf rows (via .row_id)
  soil_sf2 <- soil_sf_r[df$.row_id, ]
  train_res_sf <- soil_sf2 %>% dplyr::mutate(resid = resid)

  # 5) variogram on residuals + fit
  v_emp <- tryCatch(gstat::variogram(resid ~ 1, train_res_sf), error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(v_emp) || nrow(v_emp) < 3) {
    # if variogram fails, just return RF trend map
    message("RK residual variogram failed for ", nutrient, " -> returning RF trend only")
    return(predict_RF_final(soil_sf_r, covariate_stack, covariates, nutrient, ntree = ntree))
  }

  init_range <- max(v_emp$dist, na.rm = TRUE) / 3
  init_psill <- stats::var(resid, na.rm = TRUE)

  v_fit <- tryCatch(
    gstat::fit.variogram(
      v_emp,
      gstat::vgm(psill = init_psill, model = "Exp", nugget = 0.1 * init_psill, range = init_range)
    ),
    error = function(e) gstat::vgm(psill = init_psill, model = "Nug", nugget = 0.1 * init_psill)
  )

  # 6) RF trend raster (your safe predict logic)
  pred_df <- terra::as.data.frame(covariate_stack[[covariates]], cells = TRUE, na.rm = FALSE)
  X <- pred_df[, covariates, drop = FALSE]
  keep <- stats::complete.cases(X)

  trend_pred <- rep(NA_real_, nrow(pred_df))
  trend_pred[keep] <- as.numeric(predict(rf_mod, newdata = as.data.frame(X[keep, , drop = FALSE])))

  trend_r <- covariate_stack[[1]]
  vals <- rep(NA_real_, terra::ncell(trend_r))
  vals[pred_df$cell] <- trend_pred
  terra::values(trend_r) <- vals

  # 7) krige residuals to raster grid (grid CRS = raster CRS)
  grid_df <- terra::as.data.frame(trend_r, cells = TRUE, xy = TRUE, na.rm = FALSE) |>
  dplyr::select(cell, x, y)

    grd_sf <- sf::st_as_sf(grid_df, coords = c("x","y"),
                           crs = terra::crs(trend_r, proj = TRUE), remove = FALSE)
    
    kr_res <- gstat::krige(resid ~ 1, train_res_sf, grd_sf, model = v_fit)
    
    res_r <- trend_r
    vals_res <- rep(NA_real_, terra::ncell(res_r))
    vals_res[grid_df$cell] <- kr_res$var1.pred
    terra::values(res_r) <- vals_res
    
    trend_r + res_r

}
template_r <- covariate_stack[[1]]
out_dir <- "best_boot_maps"
dir.create(out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)

for (ds in c("SP","C")) {
  soil_sf_use <- if (ds == "SP") soil_sf_SP else soil_sf_C

  for (nut in soil_vars_to_map) {

    # OK
    cat("Mapping:", ds, nut, "OK\n")
    r_ok <- tryCatch(predict_OK_final(soil_sf_use, template_r, nut), error = function(e){message(e$message); NULL})
    if (!is.null(r_ok)) terra::writeRaster(r_ok, file.path(out_dir, sprintf("%s_%s_OK_bestboot.tif", ds, nut)), overwrite=TRUE)

    # RK
    cat("Mapping:", ds, nut, "RK\n")
    r_rk <- tryCatch(predict_RK_final(soil_sf_use, covariate_stack, covariates, nut), error = function(e){message(e$message); NULL})
    if (!is.null(r_rk)) terra::writeRaster(r_rk, file.path(out_dir, sprintf("%s_%s_RK_bestboot.tif", ds, nut)), overwrite=TRUE)
  }
}
```

### Map Panels of Best Boot Maps


```{r}

in_dir  <- "best_boot_maps"
out_dir <- "map_panels"
dir.create(out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)

methods   <- c("RF","OK","RK")
datasets  <- c("SP","C")
nutrients <- c("ca","k","mg","mn","p","zn","c","n","p_h_2")   # 9 nutrients

nut_labels <- c(ca="Ca", k="K", mg="Mg", mn="Mn", p="P", zn="Zn", c="Carbon", n="Nitrogen", p_h_2="pH")
`%||%` <- function(a, b) if (!is.null(a)) a else b

# locate file robustly (exact filename expected)
get_path <- function(ds, nut, meth){
  f <- file.path(in_dir, sprintf("%s_%s_%s_bestboot.tif", ds, nut, meth))
  if (file.exists(f)) return(f)
  return(NA_character_)
}

make_map_one <- function(r, title){
  df <- as.data.frame(r, xy = TRUE, na.rm = FALSE)
  names(df) <- c("x","y","pred")

  ggplot(df, aes(x, y, fill = pred)) +
    geom_raster() +
    coord_equal() +
    labs(title = title, x = NULL, y = NULL, fill = NULL) +
    scale_fill_viridis_c(na.value = "transparent") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face="bold", hjust=0.5, size=11),
      axis.text = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks = element_blank(),
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.key.width  = unit(2.0, "cm"),
      legend.key.height = unit(0.25, "cm"),
      legend.text  = element_text(size = 8),
      plot.margin = ggplot2::margin(2, 2, 2, 2, unit = "pt")
    )
}

# Build one patchwork for a single (method, dataset)
make_panel <- function(meth, ds, ncol = 3){

  paths <- tibble(nutrient = nutrients) %>%
    mutate(path = map_chr(nutrient, ~get_path(ds, .x, meth))) %>%
    mutate(exists = !is.na(path))

  cat("\n---", meth, ds, "---\n")
  print(paths)

  plots <- list()

  for (i in seq_len(nrow(paths))) {
    nut <- paths$nutrient[i]
    f   <- paths$path[i]
    if (is.na(f)) next

    r <- tryCatch(rast(f), error = function(e) NULL)
    if (is.null(r)) next

    lab <- nut_labels[[nut]] %||% nut
    plots[[length(plots) + 1]] <- make_map_one(r, lab)
  }

  if (length(plots) == 0) return(NULL)

  wrap_plots(plots, ncol = ncol) +
    plot_annotation(
      title = paste0(meth, " — ", ds, " (Best-boot maps)")
    ) &
    theme(plot.title = element_text(face="bold", hjust=0.5, size=16))
}

# Make 6 patchwork plots
pw_RF_SP <- make_panel("RF", "SP")
pw_RF_C  <- make_panel("RF", "C")
pw_OK_SP <- make_panel("OK", "SP")
pw_OK_C  <- make_panel("OK", "C")
pw_RK_SP <- make_panel("RK", "SP")  # likely NULL until RK rasters exist
pw_RK_C  <- make_panel("RK", "C")

pw_RF_SP; pw_RF_C
pw_OK_SP; pw_OK_C
pw_RK_SP; pw_RK_C

  ggsave(file.path(out_dir, name),
         pw,
         width = 12,
         height = 8.5,   # good for 3x3 grid
         dpi = 300)
}
```

### Variogram Diagnostics and VIP Analysis

```{r}

# -----------------------------
# Settings
# -----------------------------
soil_vars_to_use <- c("ca","k","mg","mn","p","zn","c","n","p_h_2")  # edit if needed
top_k_vip <- 6

template_r <- covariate_stack[[1]]
out_dir_vario <- "variogram_diagnostics"
out_dir_vip   <- "vip_outputs"
out_dir_vipmaps <- file.path(out_dir_vip, "vip_maps")
dir.create(out_dir_vario, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
dir.create(out_dir_vip, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
dir.create(out_dir_vipmaps, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

# Covariates (from raster stack names, robust)
soil_vars_all <- c("lbc_1","lb_ceq","p_h_2","ca","k","mg","mn","p","zn","c","n")
covariates <- setdiff(names(covariate_stack), soil_vars_all)

stopifnot(all(covariates %in% names(st_drop_geometry(soil_sf_SP))))
stopifnot(all(covariates %in% names(st_drop_geometry(soil_sf_C))))

# -----------------------------
# Helpers
# -----------------------------
align_sf_to_raster <- function(soil_sf, r){
  crs_r <- terra::crs(r, proj = TRUE)
  if (is.na(crs_r) || crs_r == "") stop("Raster has no CRS.")
  sf::st_transform(soil_sf, crs_r)
}

fit_variogram_safe <- function(v_emp, vals){
  # reasonable starts + fallback
  init_range <- max(v_emp$dist, na.rm = TRUE)/3
  init_psill <- stats::var(vals, na.rm = TRUE)
  v_fit <- tryCatch(
    gstat::fit.variogram(
      v_emp,
      gstat::vgm(psill = init_psill, model = "Exp",
                 nugget = 0.1 * init_psill, range = init_range)
    ),
    error = function(e) gstat::vgm(psill = init_psill, model = "Nug", nugget = 0.1 * init_psill)
  )
  v_fit
}

save_variogram_plot <- function(v_emp, v_fit, title, out_png){
  # model line
  vline <- tryCatch({
    vl <- gstat::variogramLine(v_fit, maxdist = max(v_emp$dist, na.rm = TRUE), n = 200)
    as_tibble(vl)
  }, error = function(e) NULL)

  p <- ggplot(as_tibble(v_emp), aes(x = dist, y = gamma)) +
    geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 0.85) +
    labs(title = title, x = "Distance", y = "Semivariance") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(face="bold", hjust = 0.5))

  if (!is.null(vline)) {
    p <- p + geom_line(data = vline, aes(x = dist, y = gamma), linewidth = 1)
  }

  ggsave(out_png, p, width = 7.2, height = 5.0, dpi = 300)
  invisible(p)
}

get_vgm_params <- function(v_fit){
  # v_fit is a data.frame-like variogram model
  # handle cases where rownames are model types
  tibble(
    model  = paste(v_fit$model, collapse = "+"),
    nugget = sum(v_fit$psill[v_fit$model == "Nug"], na.rm = TRUE),
    sill   = sum(v_fit$psill, na.rm = TRUE),
    range  = suppressWarnings(max(v_fit$range, na.rm = TRUE))
  )
}

# -----------------------------
# 1) Variogram diagnostics: OK (nutrient ~ 1)
# -----------------------------
ok_param_rows <- list()

for (ds in c("SP","C")) {

  soil_sf_use <- if (ds == "SP") soil_sf_SP else soil_sf_C
  soil_sf_use <- align_sf_to_raster(soil_sf_use, template_r)

  for (nut in soil_vars_to_use) {

    # drop NA response rows (critical for gstat)
    train_sf <- soil_sf_use %>% filter(!is.na(.data[[nut]]))
    vals <- train_sf[[nut]]

    # skip if not enough data
    if (length(vals) < 10 || length(unique(vals)) < 2) {
      message("[OK VARIO] skipping ", ds, " ", nut, " (too few non-NA/unique)")
      next
    }

    v_emp <- tryCatch(
      gstat::variogram(stats::as.formula(paste(nut, "~ 1")), train_sf),
      error = function(e) NULL
    )
    if (is.null(v_emp) || nrow(v_emp) < 3) {
      message("[OK VARIO] skipping ", ds, " ", nut, " (variogram failed)")
      next
    }

    v_fit <- fit_variogram_safe(v_emp, vals)

    out_png <- file.path(out_dir_vario, sprintf("OK_%s_%s_variogram.png", ds, nut))
    save_variogram_plot(v_emp, v_fit,
                        title = paste0("OK variogram — ", ds, " — ", nut),
                        out_png = out_png)

    params <- get_vgm_params(v_fit) %>%
      mutate(dataset = ds, method = "OK", nutrient = nut)

    ok_param_rows[[length(ok_param_rows) + 1]] <- params

    # also save empirical variogram table
    write.csv(v_emp, file.path(out_dir_vario, sprintf("OK_%s_%s_empirical.csv", ds, nut)), row.names = FALSE)
  }
}

ok_params_tbl <- bind_rows(ok_param_rows)
write.csv(ok_params_tbl, file.path(out_dir_vario, "OK_variogram_params.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

# -----------------------------
# 2) Variogram diagnostics: RK residuals (resid ~ 1)
# -----------------------------
rk_param_rows <- list()

for (ds in c("SP","C")) {

  soil_sf_use <- if (ds == "SP") soil_sf_SP else soil_sf_C
  soil_sf_use <- align_sf_to_raster(soil_sf_use, template_r)

  for (nut in soil_vars_to_use) {

    # build training df for RF trend
    df0 <- st_drop_geometry(soil_sf_use) %>%
      select(all_of(c(covariates, nut))) %>%
      mutate(.row_id = row_number())

    keep <- complete.cases(df0[, c(covariates, nut)])
    df <- df0[keep, , drop = FALSE]

    if (nrow(df) < 15) {
      message("[RK VARIO] skipping ", ds, " ", nut, " (too few complete rows)")
      next
    }

    # fit RF trend (importance not needed here)
    rf_mod <- tryCatch(
      randomForest::randomForest(
        x = df[, covariates, drop = FALSE],
        y = df[[nut]],
        ntree = 500
      ),
      error = function(e) NULL
    )
    if (is.null(rf_mod)) {
      message("[RK VARIO] skipping ", ds, " ", nut, " (RF failed)")
      next
    }

    trend <- as.numeric(predict(rf_mod, newdata = df[, covariates, drop = FALSE]))
    resid <- df[[nut]] - trend

    # attach residuals to matching sf rows
    train_res_sf <- soil_sf_use[df$.row_id, ] %>% mutate(resid = resid)

    v_emp <- tryCatch(gstat::variogram(resid ~ 1, train_res_sf), error = function(e) NULL)
    if (is.null(v_emp) || nrow(v_emp) < 3) {
      message("[RK VARIO] skipping ", ds, " ", nut, " (resid variogram failed)")
      next
    }

    v_fit <- fit_variogram_safe(v_emp, resid)

    out_png <- file.path(out_dir_vario, sprintf("RKresid_%s_%s_variogram.png", ds, nut))
    save_variogram_plot(v_emp, v_fit,
                        title = paste0("RK residual variogram — ", ds, " — ", nut),
                        out_png = out_png)

    params <- get_vgm_params(v_fit) %>%
      mutate(dataset = ds, method = "RK_residual", nutrient = nut)

    rk_param_rows[[length(rk_param_rows) + 1]] <- params

    write.csv(v_emp, file.path(out_dir_vario, sprintf("RKresid_%s_%s_empirical.csv", ds, nut)), row.names = FALSE)
  }
}

rk_params_tbl <- bind_rows(rk_param_rows)
write.csv(rk_params_tbl, file.path(out_dir_vario, "RK_residual_variogram_params.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

# -----------------------------
# 3) VIP (RF importance) for SP and C, per nutrient
# -----------------------------
get_rf_vip <- function(soil_sf, covariates, nut, ntree = 500){
  df <- st_drop_geometry(soil_sf) %>%
    select(all_of(c(covariates, nut))) %>%
    na.omit()
  if (nrow(df) < 15) return(NULL)

  rf <- randomForest::randomForest(
    x = df[, covariates, drop = FALSE],
    y = df[[nut]],
    ntree = ntree,
    importance = TRUE
  )

  imp <- randomForest::importance(rf)

  # regression: importance is matrix; keep whatever exists
  imp_tbl <- as.data.frame(imp) %>%
    tibble::rownames_to_column("covariate") %>%
    as_tibble()

  # pick a primary importance column
  # commonly: "%IncMSE" or "IncNodePurity"
  primary <- intersect(c("%IncMSE", "IncNodePurity"), names(imp_tbl))
  if (length(primary) == 0) {
    # fallback: first numeric column
    primary <- names(imp_tbl)[sapply(imp_tbl, is.numeric)][1]
  } else {
    primary <- primary[1]
  }

  imp_tbl %>%
    mutate(primary_metric = primary, importance_value = .data[[primary]]) %>%
    arrange(desc(importance_value))
}

vip_rows <- list()

for (ds in c("SP","C")) {
  soil_sf_use <- if (ds == "SP") soil_sf_SP else soil_sf_C

  for (nut in soil_vars_to_use) {
    vip_tbl <- get_rf_vip(soil_sf_use, covariates, nut)
    if (is.null(vip_tbl)) next

    vip_rows[[length(vip_rows) + 1]] <- vip_tbl %>%
      mutate(dataset = ds, nutrient = nut)
  }
}

vip_all <- bind_rows(vip_rows)
write.csv(vip_all, file.path(out_dir_vip, "vip_all.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

vip_top <- vip_all %>%
  group_by(dataset, nutrient) %>%
  slice_max(order_by = importance_value, n = top_k_vip, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup()

write.csv(vip_top, file.path(out_dir_vip, sprintf("vip_top%d.csv", top_k_vip)), row.names = FALSE)

# -----------------------------
# 4) Plot VIP covariate maps (patchwork) — SP and C separately
#    For each nutrient, map its top_k covariates from vip_top
# -----------------------------
make_cov_map <- function(r, title){
  df <- as.data.frame(r, xy = TRUE, na.rm = FALSE)
  names(df) <- c("x","y","val")

  ggplot(df, aes(x, y, fill = val)) +
    geom_raster() +
    coord_equal() +
    labs(title = title, x = NULL, y = NULL, fill = NULL) +
    scale_fill_viridis_c(na.value = "transparent") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face="bold", hjust=0.5, size=11),
      axis.text = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks = element_blank(),
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.key.width  = unit(2.0, "cm"),
      legend.key.height = unit(0.25, "cm"),
      legend.text  = element_text(size = 8),
      plot.margin = ggplot2::margin(2, 2, 2, 2, unit = "pt")
    )
}

plot_vip_maps_one <- function(dataset_label, nutrient, vip_top_tbl, covariate_stack, top_k = 6, ncol = 3){
  sel <- vip_top_tbl %>%
    filter(dataset == dataset_label, nutrient == nutrient) %>%
    slice_head(n = top_k)

  if (nrow(sel) == 0) return(NULL)

  plots <- list()
  for (cv in sel$covariate) {
    if (!cv %in% names(covariate_stack)) next
    r <- covariate_stack[[cv]]
    plots[[length(plots) + 1]] <- make_cov_map(r, cv)
  }

  if (length(plots) == 0) return(NULL)

  wrap_plots(plots, ncol = ncol) +
    plot_annotation(title = paste0("Top ", top_k, " RF predictors — ", dataset_label, " — ", nutrient)) &
    theme(plot.title = element_text(face="bold", hjust=0.5, size=16))
}

# build and save VIP map panels (per dataset + nutrient)
for (ds in c("SP","C")) {
  for (nut in soil_vars_to_use) {

    pw <- plot_vip_maps_one(ds, nut, vip_top, covariate_stack, top_k = top_k_vip, ncol = 3)
    if (is.null(pw)) next

    out_png <- file.path(out_dir_vipmaps, sprintf("VIPmaps_%s_%s_top%d.png", ds, nut, top_k_vip))
    ggsave(out_png, pw, width = 12, height = 8.5, dpi = 300)
  }
}

cat("\nDone.\n",
    "Variograms saved in: ", out_dir_vario, "\n",
    "VIP tables saved in: ", out_dir_vip, "\n",
    "VIP map panels saved in: ", out_dir_vipmaps, "\n")
```

### VIP Analysis for RF and RK Models with SR Indices

```{r}
#VIPS for RF and RK models with SR indices:
#cov stack:
covariate_stack_idx <- terra::rast("../LOCAL DATA DO NOT PUSH/covariate_stack/covariate_stack_3m_all_with_SR_indices.tif")


# stack with indices + covariates you want to use
stack_use <- covariate_stack_idx

# soil variables you want to predict (keep these from the point table)
soil_vars_all <- c("lbc_1","lb_ceq","p_h_2","ca","k","mg","mn","p","zn","c","n")

extract_covs_to_points_nodupes <- function(soil_sf, rstack, soil_vars_all){

  # 1) align CRS to raster
  soil_sf_r <- st_transform(soil_sf, terra::crs(rstack, proj = TRUE))

  # 2) keep ONLY soil vars that exist + geometry (prevents duplicates later)
  keep_soils <- intersect(soil_vars_all, names(soil_sf_r))
  soil_sf_min <- soil_sf_r %>% dplyr::select(all_of(keep_soils), geometry)

  # 3) extract all raster layers to points
  ex <- terra::extract(rstack, terra::vect(soil_sf_min))

  # 4) bind extracted values back by row order (ID is 1..n in order)
  #    ex includes ID + raster columns
  ex <- ex %>% dplyr::select(-ID)

  out <- dplyr::bind_cols(soil_sf_min, ex)

  # 5) sanity check: extracted covariates should match raster names exactly
  stopifnot(all(names(rstack) %in% names(out)))

  out
}

soil_sf_SP2 <- extract_covs_to_points_nodupes(soil_sf_SP, stack_use, soil_vars_all)
soil_sf_C2  <- extract_covs_to_points_nodupes(soil_sf_C,  stack_use, soil_vars_all)

# covariates are exactly raster names minus soil variables (if any overlap)
covariates <- setdiff(names(stack_use), soil_vars_all)

# sanity checks (these should PASS now)
stopifnot(all(covariates %in% names(st_drop_geometry(soil_sf_SP2))))
stopifnot(all(covariates %in% names(st_drop_geometry(soil_sf_C2))))

cat("✅ Extraction complete with NO duplicate .x/.y columns\n")
cat("Covariates used:", length(covariates), "\n")
cat("First covariates:", paste(head(covariates, 12), collapse = ", "), "\n")

# -----------------------------
# 1) Fit RF + extract VIP (bar-graph-ready)
# -----------------------------
get_vip_one <- function(soil_sf, covariates, nutrient, ntree = 500, seed = 1){

  set.seed(seed)

  df <- st_drop_geometry(soil_sf) %>%
    select(all_of(c(covariates, nutrient))) %>%
    na.omit()

  if (nrow(df) < 15) return(NULL)

  rf <- randomForest::randomForest(
    x = df[, covariates, drop = FALSE],
    y = df[[nutrient]],
    ntree = ntree,
    importance = TRUE
  )

  imp <- randomForest::importance(rf) %>% as.data.frame()
  imp <- tibble::rownames_to_column(imp, "covariate")

  # pick a primary importance column (prefer %IncMSE)
  primary <- intersect(c("%IncMSE", "IncNodePurity"), names(imp))
  primary <- if (length(primary) == 0) names(imp)[sapply(imp, is.numeric)][1] else primary[1]

  imp %>%
    transmute(
      covariate,
      importance_metric = primary,
      importance_value = .data[[primary]]
    ) %>%
    arrange(desc(importance_value))
}

# -----------------------------
# 2) Build VIP table for SP/C and RF/RK
#    (RK uses RF trend VIP; we label it "RK" so you can plot alongside RF.)
# -----------------------------
vip_rows <- list()

for (ds in c("SP","C")) {

  soil_sf_use <- if (ds == "SP") soil_sf_SP2 else soil_sf_C2

  for (nut in soil_vars_to_map) {

    vip_rf <- get_vip_one(soil_sf_use, covariates, nut, ntree = 500, seed = 1)

    if (!is.null(vip_rf)) {

      vip_rf <- vip_rf %>%
        mutate(dataset = ds, method = "RF", nutrient = nut)

      # RK “VIP” = same RF-trend VIP (because RK trend is RF)
      vip_rk <- vip_rf %>%
        mutate(method = "RK")

      vip_rows[[length(vip_rows) + 1]] <- vip_rf
      vip_rows[[length(vip_rows) + 1]] <- vip_rk
    }
  }
}

vip_all <- bind_rows(vip_rows) %>%
  group_by(dataset, method, nutrient) %>%
  mutate(rank = row_number()) %>%
  ungroup()

# Save bar-graph data
dir.create("vip_outputs", showWarnings = FALSE)
write.csv(vip_all, "vip_outputs/vip_all_RF_RK_SP_C.csv", row.names = FALSE)

# -----------------------------
# 3) Quick bar plot (top K predictors per nutrient)
# -----------------------------
top_k <- 10

vip_plot_dat <- vip_all %>%
  filter(rank <= top_k) %>%
  mutate(covariate = reorder_within(covariate, importance_value, interaction(dataset, method, nutrient)))

# helper for reorder_within
reorder_within <- function(x, by, within, fun = mean, sep = "___", ...) {
  new_x <- paste(x, within, sep = sep)
  stats::reorder(new_x, by, FUN = fun)
}
scale_x_reordered <- function(..., sep = "___") {
  ggplot2::scale_x_discrete(labels = function(x) sub(paste0(sep, ".*$"), "", x), ...)
}

p_vip <- ggplot(vip_plot_dat, aes(x = covariate, y = importance_value)) +
  geom_col() +
  coord_flip() +
  facet_grid(nutrient ~ dataset + method, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_x_reordered() +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 8) +
  labs(
    title = paste0("Top ", top_k, " VIP predictors (new indices)"),
    x = NULL,
    y = "Importance"
  )
```

```{r}

top_k <- 5

# 1) Top K per nutrient PER dataset (SP and C separately)

  filter(method == method_keep,

# 2) Per-nutrient x-limit (shared within nutrient so SP/C comparable)

  group_by(nutrient) %>%
  summarize(xmax = max(importance_value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%

make_one_nutrient_plot <- function(df_nut, title_txt, xmax){

  # dataset-specific y-key so each facet can have its own ordering
  df_nut <- df_nut %>%
    mutate(cov_plot = paste(dataset_lab, covariate, sep = "___")) %>%
    group_by(dataset_lab) %>%
    arrange(importance_value, .by_group = TRUE) %>%  # low->high (so high ends up top after flip-like reading)
    mutate(cov_plot = factor(cov_plot, levels = unique(cov_plot))) %>%
    ungroup()

  ggplot(df_nut, aes(x = importance_value, y = cov_plot, fill = dataset_lab)) +
    geom_col(width = 0.75, alpha = 0.95) +
    facet_wrap(~ dataset_lab, nrow = 1, scales = "free_y") +
    scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, xmax), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0))) +
    # strip the dataset prefix from y labels
    scale_y_discrete(labels = function(x) sub("^.*___", "", x)) +
    labs(title = title_txt, x = "VIP", y = NULL) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11, hjust = 0.5),
      strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 9),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 8),
      legend.position = "none",
      panel.grid.major.y = element_blank()
    )
}

  })
```

```{r}
# -----------------------------
# SETTINGS
# -----------------------------
map_dir <- "C:/git/Perry_surface_analysis/code/best_boot_maps"
dataset_keep <- "SP"
soil_vars_to_validate <- c("ca","k","mg","mn","p","zn","c","n","p_h_2")
methods <- c("RF","OK","RK")

stopifnot(exists("validation_sf_fix"))
val_v <- terra::vect(validation_sf_fix)

# -----------------------------
# Index map files
# -----------------------------
map_files <- list.files(map_dir, pattern = "\\.tif$", full.names = TRUE)

map_index <- tibble(path = map_files, file = basename(map_files)) %>%
  mutate(
    dataset = str_match(file, "^(SP|C)_")[,2],
    method  = str_match(file, "_(RF|OK|RK)_bestboot\\.tif$")[,2],
    nutrient = str_match(file, "^(SP|C)_(.*)_(RF|OK|RK)_bestboot\\.tif$")[,3]
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(dataset), !is.na(method), !is.na(nutrient))

map_index_use <- map_index %>%
  filter(dataset == dataset_keep, method %in% methods, nutrient %in% soil_vars_to_validate)

# -----------------------------
# Extract predictions -> long table
# -----------------------------
extract_one <- function(nut, meth){
  if(!nut %in% names(validation_sf_fix)) {
    return(tibble(observed = numeric(0), predicted = numeric(0)))
  }

  obs <- as.numeric(validation_sf_fix[[nut]])

  row_match <- map_index_use %>% filter(nutrient == nut, method == meth)
  if(nrow(row_match) == 0){
    return(tibble(observed = obs, predicted = rep(NA_real_, length(obs))))
  }

  r <- terra::rast(row_match$path[1])
  val_v_use <- if(!terra::same.crs(r, val_v)) terra::project(val_v, terra::crs(r)) else val_v

  ex <- terra::extract(r, val_v_use)
  pred <- if(!is.null(ex) && nrow(ex) == length(obs)) as.numeric(ex[[2]]) else rep(NA_real_, length(obs))

  tibble(observed = obs, predicted = pred)
}

val_pred_long <- crossing(nutrient = soil_vars_to_validate, method = methods) %>%
  mutate(dat = map2(nutrient, method, extract_one)) %>%
  unnest(dat) %>%
  mutate(dataset = dataset_keep) %>%
  filter(is.finite(observed), is.finite(predicted))

stopifnot(nrow(val_pred_long) > 0)

# -----------------------------
# Metrics
# -----------------------------
safe_r2 <- function(o, p){
  ok <- is.finite(o) & is.finite(p)
  if(sum(ok) < 2) return(NA_real_)
  cc <- suppressWarnings(cor(o[ok], p[ok], use="complete.obs"))
  if(is.na(cc)) NA_real_ else cc^2
}

val_metrics <- val_pred_long %>%
  group_by(dataset, nutrient, method) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    RMSE = sqrt(mean((predicted - observed)^2)),
    R2   = safe_r2(observed, predicted),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    lab = paste0("n=", n,
                 "\nRMSE=", format(round(RMSE, 3), nsmall = 3),
                 "\nR²=",   ifelse(is.na(R2), "NA", format(round(R2, 3), nsmall = 3)))
  )

print(val_metrics)

# -----------------------------
# Pretty nutrient labels
# -----------------------------

make_one_nutrient_plot <- function(nut){

  df  <- val_pred_long %>% filter(nutrient == nut)
  met <- val_metrics    %>% filter(nutrient == nut)

  # ---- if NOTHING to facet, return a placeholder plot ----
  if(nrow(df) == 0){

        theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5))
    )
  }

  df <- df %>% mutate(method = factor(method, levels = methods))
  met <- met %>% mutate(method = factor(method, levels = methods))

  ggplot(df, aes(observed, predicted)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.85, size = 2) +
    geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, linewidth = 0.8) +
    facet_wrap(~ method, scales = "free") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    labs(
      title = paste0("Validation: ", nut_labs[[nut]] %||% nut, " (", dataset_keep, ")"),
      x = "Observed (validation)",
      y = "Predicted (map)"
    ) +
    theme(
      strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5)
    ) +

      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      hjust = -0.05, vjust = 1.1,
      size = 3,
      label.size = 0.2
    )
}
```

### Validation: Standardized Errors and “How Far Off?” Plots

```{r}


# val_pred_long must have: nutrient, method, observed, predicted
# example methods: "RF","OK","RK"
stopifnot(all(c("nutrient","method","observed","predicted") %in% names(val_pred_long)))

# 1) Compute validation metrics from val_pred_long (so we don't rely on a separate table)
val_metrics <- val_pred_long %>%
  group_by(nutrient, method) %>%
  summarise(
    n = sum(is.finite(observed) & is.finite(predicted)),
    RMSE = sqrt(mean((predicted - observed)^2, na.rm = TRUE)),
    R2 = {cc <- suppressWarnings(cor(observed, predicted, use = "complete.obs")); ifelse(is.na(cc), NA_real_, cc^2)},
    sd_obs = sd(observed, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# 2) Standardize errors: by RMSE (recommended) + by observed SD (optional)
val_std <- val_pred_long %>%
  left_join(val_metrics, by = c("nutrient","method")) %>%
  mutate(
    err = predicted - observed,
    z_rmse = err / RMSE,                     # "how many RMSEs off?"
    z_sd   = err / sd_obs,                   # "how many observed SDs off?"
    abs_z_rmse = abs(z_rmse)
  ) %>%
  filter(is.finite(z_rmse))

# 3) Nice labels (edit if you want)
nut_labs <- c(
  ca="Ca", k="K", mg="Mg", mn="Mn", p="P", zn="Zn", c="C", n="N", p_h_2="pH"
)

val_std <- val_std %>%
  mutate(
    nutrient_lab = ifelse(nutrient %in% names(nut_labs), nut_labs[nutrient], nutrient),
    method = factor(method, levels = c("OK","RF","RK"))
  )

# ---- PLOT 1: Distribution of standardized errors (by RMSE) ----
# Interpretation: 0 = perfect; +/-1 = off by 1 RMSE; +/-2 = off by 2 RMSE
p1 <- ggplot(val_std, aes(x = z_rmse, fill = method)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 15, alpha = 0.6, position = "identity") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.7) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-1, 1), linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.6) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-2, 2), linetype = "dotted", linewidth = 0.6) +
  facet_wrap(~ nutrient_lab, scales = "free_y") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  labs(
    title = "Validation: standardized prediction error (in RMSE units)",
    x = "(Predicted − Observed) / RMSE  [per nutrient + method]",
    y = "Count",
    fill = "Method"
  ) +
  theme(legend.position = "top")
print(p1)

# ---- PLOT 2: “How far off?” absolute standardized errors ----
# This one is super intuitive: lower is better.
p2 <- val_std %>%
  group_by(nutrient_lab, method) %>%
  summarise(
    n = dplyr::n(),
    median_abs = median(abs_z_rmse, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_abs = mean(abs_z_rmse, na.rm = TRUE),
    p90_abs = quantile(abs_z_rmse, 0.90, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = nutrient_lab, y = median_abs, color = method, group = method)) +
  geom_point(size = 2.6) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.7) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  labs(
    title = "Validation: median absolute error in RMSE units (lower = better)",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Median |(Pred−Obs)/RMSE|",
    color = "Method"
  ) +
  theme(legend.position = "top")
print(p2)

# ---- SUMMARY TABLE: % within 1 RMSE and 2 RMSE ----
val_within <- val_std %>%
  group_by(nutrient_lab, method) %>%
  summarise(
    n = dplyr::n(),
    pct_within_1 = mean(abs_z_rmse <= 1, na.rm = TRUE) * 100,
    pct_within_2 = mean(abs_z_rmse <= 2, na.rm = TRUE) * 100,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(nutrient_lab, method)

print(val_within)

#nice table:
library(knitr)
val_within %>%
  kable(
    caption = "Validation: Percentage of predictions within 1 RMSE and 2 RMSE",
    col.names = c("Nutrient", "Method", "N", "% within 1 RMSE", "% within 2 RMSE"),
    digits = c(0,0,0,1,1)
  )
```
