### MZ maps for P

```{r}


# -----------------------------
# 0) Settings you control
# -----------------------------
map_dir  <- "C:/git/Perry_surface_analysis/code/best_boot_maps"  # adjust if needed
dataset  <- "SP"
nutrient <- "p"

# IMPORTANT: set to the depth your P map represents
depth_cm <- 15      # <-- change to 20 if your P map is 0–20 cm
bd_gcm3  <- 1.33    # bulk density assumption (g/cm3)

# -----------------------------
# 1) Coastal Plain P thresholds (lbs/ac) from your table
# -----------------------------
# Low: 0–30, Medium: 31–60, High: 61–100, Very High: 100+
p_lbs_breaks <- c(0, 30, 60, 100, Inf)

# -----------------------------
# 2) Convert lbs/ac thresholds -> ppm thresholds for your depth + BD
#    ppm_to_lbsac(1 ppm) gives the lbs/ac per ppm at that depth.
# -----------------------------
ppm_to_lbsac_factor <- function(depth_cm, bulk_density_gcm3 = 1.33){
  area_m2 <- 4046.8564224
  depth_m <- depth_cm / 100
  bd_kgm3 <- bulk_density_gcm3 * 1000
  soil_mass_kg <- area_m2 * depth_m * bd_kgm3
  # 1 ppm = 1 mg/kg, so lbs/ac per ppm:
  (soil_mass_kg * 2.2046226218) / 1e6
}

lbs_per_ppm <- ppm_to_lbsac_factor(depth_cm, bd_gcm3)

# Convert lbs/ac breaks to ppm breaks (same number of breaks)
# (Inf stays Inf)
p_ppm_breaks <- p_lbs_breaks
p_ppm_breaks[is.finite(p_ppm_breaks)] <- p_ppm_breaks[is.finite(p_ppm_breaks)] / lbs_per_ppm

cat("Depth (cm):", depth_cm, " BD:", bd_gcm3, "\n")
cat("lbs/ac per ppm:", round(lbs_per_ppm, 4), "\n")
cat("P thresholds (lbs/ac):", paste(p_lbs_breaks, collapse=" | "), "\n")
cat("P thresholds (ppm)   :", paste(round(p_ppm_breaks, 2), collapse=" | "), "\n\n")

# -----------------------------
# 3) Helper to bin a ppm raster into categorical zones
# -----------------------------
classify_P_zones_ppm <- function(r_ppm, breaks_ppm, breaks_lbs){
  # Create a categorical raster with classes 1..4
  # zones: [0,b1], (b1,b2], (b2,b3], (b3,Inf]
  r_cat <- classify(r_ppm, rcl = matrix(c(
    -Inf, breaks_ppm[2], 1,
    breaks_ppm[2], breaks_ppm[3], 2,
    breaks_ppm[3], breaks_ppm[4], 3,
    breaks_ppm[4],  Inf,          4
  ), ncol = 3, byrow = TRUE), include.lowest = TRUE, right = TRUE)

  r_cat <- as.factor(r_cat)

  # Pretty labels include BOTH ppm & lbs/ac ranges
  lab <- c(
    paste0("Low (≤",   round(breaks_ppm[2],2), " ppm; ≤", breaks_lbs[2], " lb/ac)"),
    paste0("Medium (", round(breaks_ppm[2],2), "–", round(breaks_ppm[3],2), " ppm; ",
           breaks_lbs[2]+1, "–", breaks_lbs[3], " lb/ac)"),
    paste0("High (",   round(breaks_ppm[3],2), "–", round(breaks_ppm[4],2), " ppm; ",
           breaks_lbs[3]+1, "–", breaks_lbs[4], " lb/ac)"),
    paste0("Very High (>", round(breaks_ppm[4],2), " ppm; >", breaks_lbs[4], " lb/ac)")
  )

  levels(r_cat) <- data.frame(value = 1:4, zone = lab)
  r_cat
}

# -----------------------------
# 4) Load SP P rasters for RF / OK / RK and classify
# -----------------------------
methods <- c("RF","OK","RK")

p_maps <- lapply(methods, function(m){
  f <- file.path(map_dir, sprintf("%s_%s_%s_bestboot.tif", dataset, nutrient, m))
  if(!file.exists(f)) stop("Missing file: ", f)
  rast(f)
})
names(p_maps) <- methods

p_zones <- lapply(p_maps, classify_P_zones_ppm, breaks_ppm = p_ppm_breaks, breaks_lbs = p_lbs_breaks)

# -----------------------------
# 5) Plot side-by-side (not saving yet)
# -----------------------------
op <- par(no.readonly = TRUE)
par(mfrow = c(1,3), mar = c(3,3,4,7))

for(m in methods){
  plot(p_zones[[m]],
       main = sprintf("P Zones (%s %s)\nDepth=%scm  BD=%s", dataset, m, depth_cm, bd_gcm3),
       axes = FALSE)
}

par(op)
```

```{r}

# -----------------------------
# SETTINGS
# -----------------------------
map_dir  <- "C:/git/Perry_surface_analysis/code/best_boot_maps"
dataset  <- "SP"
nutrient <- "p"
methods  <- c("RF","OK","RK")

# Your UGA Coastal Plain thresholds (lbs/ac)
p_lbs_breaks <- c(0, 30, 60, 100, Inf)

# Choose ONE binning basis for EVERYTHING:
#   "ppm"  = assume raster+validation are ppm
#   "lbs"  = assume raster+validation should be treated as lbs/ac
bin_basis <- "lbs"   # <-- TRY "lbs" FIRST given your weird result

# Conversion settings (only used if we need ppm <-> lbs/ac)
depth_cm <- 15
bd_gcm3  <- 1.33

# -----------------------------
# 1) Read reference raster for CRS
# -----------------------------
r_ref <- rast(file.path(map_dir, "SP_c_RF_bestboot.tif"))  # EPSG:26917

# -----------------------------
# 2) Validation points (your fix: x/y are EPSG:3857)
# -----------------------------
validation_data <- read.csv("../LOCAL DATA DO NOT PUSH/covariates_and_soil_data/perry_fp_Ap_0_20_with_coords.csv") %>%
  mutate(x = as.numeric(x), y = as.numeric(y))

validation_sf_fix <- st_as_sf(validation_data, coords = c("x","y"), crs = 3857, remove = FALSE) %>%
  st_transform(terra::crs(r_ref, proj = TRUE))

stopifnot(nutrient %in% names(validation_sf_fix))
val_v <- vect(validation_sf_fix)

# overlap check
inside <- relate(val_v, r_ref, "intersects")
cat("Points intersect raster extent:", sum(inside), "of", length(inside), "\n")

# -----------------------------
# 3) Helpers
# -----------------------------
ppm_to_lbsac_factor <- function(depth_cm, bulk_density_gcm3 = 1.33){
  area_m2 <- 4046.8564224
  depth_m <- depth_cm / 100
  bd_kgm3 <- bulk_density_gcm3 * 1000
  soil_mass_kg <- area_m2 * depth_m * bd_kgm3
  (soil_mass_kg * 2.2046226218) / 1e6  # lbs/ac per ppm
}

lbs_per_ppm <- ppm_to_lbsac_factor(depth_cm, bd_gcm3)

# Binning function (returns 1..4)
bin_P <- function(x, breaks){
  as.integer(cut(x,
    breaks = c(-Inf, breaks[2], breaks[3], breaks[4], Inf),
    labels = 1:4, right = TRUE, include.lowest = TRUE
  ))
}

# -----------------------------
# 4) Extract RAW predicted values at points
# -----------------------------
# --- Extract RAW predicted values at points (FIXED) ---
extract_pred_vals <- function(meth){
  f <- file.path(map_dir, sprintf("%s_%s_%s_bestboot.tif", dataset, nutrient, meth))
  if(!file.exists(f)) stop("Missing raster: ", f)

  r <- terra::rast(f)

  val_use <- if(!terra::same.crs(r, val_v)) terra::project(val_v, terra::crs(r)) else val_v

  ex <- terra::extract(r, val_use)   # <-- force terra::extract
  as.numeric(ex[[2]])
}


obs_ppm <- as.numeric(validation_sf_fix[[nutrient]])

pred_tbl <- tibble(
  id = seq_along(obs_ppm),
  observed_ppm = obs_ppm,
  RF = extract_pred_vals("RF"),
  OK = extract_pred_vals("OK"),
  RK = extract_pred_vals("RK")
) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = all_of(methods), names_to = "method", values_to = "pred_raw") %>%
  filter(is.finite(observed_ppm), is.finite(pred_raw))

# -----------------------------
# 5) DEBUG PRINTS: are rasters ppm or lbs?
# -----------------------------
cat("\n--- Observed P (validation) summary (ppm) ---\n")
print(summary(pred_tbl$observed_ppm))

cat("\n--- Predicted RAW P summary by method (whatever units raster is in) ---\n")
print(pred_tbl %>% group_by(method) %>% summarise(
  n = n(),
  min = min(pred_raw, na.rm=TRUE),
  q25 = quantile(pred_raw, 0.25, na.rm=TRUE),
  med = median(pred_raw, na.rm=TRUE),
  q75 = quantile(pred_raw, 0.75, na.rm=TRUE),
  max = max(pred_raw, na.rm=TRUE)
))

cat("\n--- Quick ratio check: median(pred)/median(obs) ---\n")
print(pred_tbl %>% group_by(method) %>% summarise(
  ratio_med = median(pred_raw, na.rm=TRUE) / median(observed_ppm, na.rm=TRUE)
))

# If ratio ~2 (or >>2), your raster is probably NOT ppm.

# -----------------------------
# 6) Put OBSERVED and PREDICTED on same binning basis
# -----------------------------
if(bin_basis == "ppm"){
  # interpret table thresholds as lbs/ac, convert thresholds -> ppm (your earlier approach)
  p_ppm_breaks <- p_lbs_breaks
  p_ppm_breaks[is.finite(p_ppm_breaks)] <- p_ppm_breaks[is.finite(p_ppm_breaks)] / lbs_per_ppm

  cat("\nUsing bin_basis = ppm\n")
  cat("lbs/ac per ppm:", round(lbs_per_ppm, 4), "\n")
  cat("P thresholds (ppm):", paste(round(p_ppm_breaks, 2), collapse=" | "), "\n")

  pred_tbl2 <- pred_tbl %>%
    mutate(
      obs_bin  = bin_P(observed_ppm, p_ppm_breaks),
      pred_bin = bin_P(pred_raw,      p_ppm_breaks)
    )

} else {
  # bin_basis == "lbs": convert observed ppm -> lbs/ac, and assume raster pred_raw is ALSO lbs/ac
  # (This is the most likely fix if your rasters were already converted or are “furrow-slice-like”.)
  cat("\nUsing bin_basis = lbs\n")
  cat("lbs/ac per ppm factor:", round(lbs_per_ppm, 4), "\n")

  pred_tbl2 <- pred_tbl %>%
    mutate(
      observed_lbs = observed_ppm * lbs_per_ppm,
      obs_bin  = bin_P(observed_lbs, p_lbs_breaks),
      pred_bin = bin_P(pred_raw,     p_lbs_breaks)
    )
}

# -----------------------------
# 7) Accuracy on bins (overall + within 1 bin)
# -----------------------------
mz_accuracy <- pred_tbl2 %>%
  group_by(method) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    accuracy = mean(obs_bin == pred_bin),
    pct_accuracy = 100 * accuracy,
    pct_within_1_bin = 100 * mean(abs(obs_bin - pred_bin) <= 1),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

cat("\n--- Bin accuracy ---\n")
print(mz_accuracy)

cat("\n--- Counts table (like a confusion matrix) ---\n")
print(pred_tbl2 %>% count(method, obs_bin, pred_bin) %>% arrange(method, obs_bin, pred_bin))

nutrient <- "p"
methods  <- c("RF","OK","RK")
P_0_15 <- read.csv("../LOCAL DATA DO NOT PUSH/Ap_hz_data/P_0_15_clean_test_02_10_2026.csv")  # must have Point, value_0_15
depth_cm <- 15
bd_gcm3  <- 1.33

# Coastal Plain P thresholds (lbs/ac) from your table
p_lbs_breaks <- c(0, 30, 60, 100, Inf)

ppm_to_lbsac_factor <- function(depth_cm, bulk_density_gcm3 = 1.33){
  area_m2 <- 4046.8564224
  depth_m <- depth_cm / 100
  bd_kgm3 <- bulk_density_gcm3 * 1000
  soil_mass_kg <- area_m2 * depth_m * bd_kgm3
  (soil_mass_kg * 2.2046226218) / 1e6
}
lbs_per_ppm <- ppm_to_lbsac_factor(depth_cm, bd_gcm3)

# Convert lbs/ac breaks -> ppm breaks (0–15 cm support)
p_ppm_breaks <- p_lbs_breaks
p_ppm_breaks[is.finite(p_ppm_breaks)] <- p_ppm_breaks[is.finite(p_ppm_breaks)] / lbs_per_ppm

cat("P breaks (lbs/ac):", paste(p_lbs_breaks, collapse=" | "), "\n")
cat("P breaks (ppm)   :", paste(round(p_ppm_breaks, 2), collapse=" | "), "\n\n")

# -----------------------------
# 1) Observed P for validation = depth-weighted 0–15 cm per Point
#    ASSUMES you already made P_0_15 with: Point, value_0_15
# -----------------------------
stopifnot(exists("validation_sf_fix"))
stopifnot(exists("P_0_15"))
stopifnot(all(c("Point","value_0_15") %in% names(P_0_15)))

#rename P_0_15 Point to match validation_sf_fix
P_0_15 <- P_0_15 %>%
  rename(PointLabel = Point)

val_pts <- validation_sf_fix %>%
  left_join(P_0_15, by = "PointLabel") %>%
  filter(is.finite(value_0_15))


cat("Validation points with depth-harmonized P (0–15):", nrow(val_pts), "\n")

# classify observed bins (1..4) using ppm thresholds
bin_from_ppm <- function(x, breaks_ppm){
  cut(x,
      breaks = breaks_ppm,
      include.lowest = TRUE,
      right = TRUE,
      labels = FALSE)
}

val_pts <- val_pts %>%
  mutate(obs_bin = bin_from_ppm(value_0_15, p_ppm_breaks))

# terra points object
val_v <- terra::vect(val_pts)

# -----------------------------
# 2) Make / load zone rasters for each method and extract predicted bin
#    IMPORTANT: classify zones based on ppm breaks (same as observed)
# -----------------------------
classify_P_zones_ppm <- function(r_ppm, breaks_ppm){
  # output values 1..4
  terra::classify(
    r_ppm,
    rcl = matrix(c(
      -Inf, breaks_ppm[2], 1,
      breaks_ppm[2], breaks_ppm[3], 2,
      breaks_ppm[3], breaks_ppm[4], 3,
      breaks_ppm[4],  Inf,          4
    ), ncol = 3, byrow = TRUE),
    include.lowest = TRUE,
    right = TRUE
  )
}

extract_pred_bin <- function(meth){

  f <- file.path(map_dir, sprintf("%s_%s_%s_bestboot.tif", dataset, nutrient, meth))
  stopifnot(file.exists(f))

  r_ppm <- terra::rast(f)

  # zone raster (1..4)
  r_zone <- classify_P_zones_ppm(r_ppm, p_ppm_breaks)

  # extract
  ex <- terra::extract(r_zone, val_v)
  pred_bin <- as.integer(ex[[2]])

  tibble(
    method = meth,
    Point = val_pts$Point,
    observed_ppm_0_15 = val_pts$value_0_15,
    obs_bin = val_pts$obs_bin,
    pred_bin = pred_bin
  )
}

mz_val_long <- bind_rows(lapply(methods, extract_pred_bin)) %>%
  filter(is.finite(obs_bin), is.finite(pred_bin))

stopifnot(nrow(mz_val_long) > 0)

# -----------------------------
# 3) Accuracy metrics on bins
# -----------------------------
mz_metrics <- mz_val_long %>%
  group_by(method) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    accuracy = mean(pred_bin == obs_bin),
    pct_accuracy = 100 * accuracy,
    pct_within_1_bin = 100 * mean(abs(pred_bin - obs_bin) <= 1),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

print(mz_metrics)

# confusion-ish counts
mz_counts <- mz_val_long %>%
  count(method, obs_bin, pred_bin) %>%
  arrange(method, obs_bin, pred_bin)

print(mz_counts)

# Optional: nice labels for bins
bin_labels <- tibble(
  bin = 1:4,
  label = c("Low", "Medium", "High", "Very High")
)

mz_counts_labeled <- mz_counts %>%
  left_join(bin_labels, by = c("obs_bin" = "bin")) %>%
  rename(obs_label = label) %>%
  left_join(bin_labels, by = c("pred_bin" = "bin")) %>%
  rename(pred_label = label)

print(mz_counts_labeled)
```
